abstract: Programmable design of RNA sequences with defined functions remains a central challenge in biology. Despite recent advances, existing RNA generative models lack robust controllable design capabilities and are constrained by short context windows, limiting their capacity to model the complex evolutionary manifold of full-length transcripts. Here we introduce EVA (Evolutionary Versatile Architect), a long-context generative RNA foundation model trained on over 114 million full-length RNA sequences spanning the full breadth of evolutionary diversity. By integrating a mixture-of-experts architecture with an 8,192-token context window, EVA learns a unified, evolution-consistent representation of the RNA sequence space that captures both global transcript structure and fine-grained functional elements. EVA establishes a unified framework for a broad spectrum of RNA design tasks within a single architecture, ranging from mutational fitness prediction to context-aware sequence engineering. We demonstrate EVA’s versatility through de novo design and targeted optimization of diverse RNA classes, including transfers RNAs, aptamers and CRISPR guide RNAs, as well as messenger RNA and circular RNA therapeutics. In wet-lab assays, our best designed aptamers improve both fluorescence intensity and binding affinity by roughly twofold over the positive control. In systematic evaluations, EVA achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven of nine established benchmarks, generating sequences with more than tenfold lower Kullback–Leibler divergence to natural RNA secondary-structure feature distributions than the previous open-source RNA generator.

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for mental health support despite lacking mechanisms to safely govern evolving risk. Existing safety approaches primarily detect risk but rarely shape how models respond as conversational risk unfolds. We developed a portable, model-external safety governance architecture that combines contextual risk detection, reasoning-based verification, and protocol-guided response generation for multi-turn mental health interactions. Using synthetic conversations grounded in real-world mental health narratives, the architecture’s performance was assessed with GPT-5-chat and Qwen3.5-27B, increasing clinician-preferred escalation responses by 25.6–59.2 pp, while achieving high risk detection performance (specificity: 0.85 (95%CI: 0.78;0.91), sensitivity: 0.92 (95%CI: 0.89;0.95)). Performance remained stable across conversation length and across models (proprietary and open-source), with preliminary evidence showing that rapport and connection were preserved. These findings demonstrate that clinically-grounded governance can extend beyond risk detection to improve how LLMs manage evolving mental health risk, providing a framework for scalable safety governance.
zh_abstract: 尽管缺乏安全管控不断变化风险的机制，大语言模型（LLM）仍越来越多地用于心理健康支持。现有安全方法主要侧重于检测风险，却很少塑造模型在对话风险逐步展开时的应答方式。我们开发了一种可移植的、模型外置的安全治理架构，将情境化风险检测、基于推理的验证以及遵循规程引导的应答生成相结合，用于多轮心理健康互动。我们使用以真实世界心理健康叙述为基础的合成对话，以 GPT-5-chat 和 Qwen3.5-27B 评估该架构的性能：临床医生偏好的升级处置应答增加了 25.6–59.2 个百分点，同时风险检测性能较高（特异度：0.85（95%CI：0.78；0.91），敏感度：0.92（95%CI：0.89；0.95））。其性能在不同对话长度和不同模型（专有与开源）之间保持稳定，初步证据表明融洽关系与联结得以保持。这些发现表明，以临床为基础的治理不仅可用于风险检测，还能改善大语言模型管理不断变化的心理健康风险的方式，为可扩展的安全治理提供了框架。

title: Generating proteins with computationally predicted functions and multiple states via multimodal diffusion

summary: 提出多模态扩散Transformer ProDiT，基于1.28亿蛋白的序列、结构与注释训练，可按463个GO术语条件生成蛋白，并设计多功能状态蛋白。

abstract: Generating proteins with the full diversity and complexity of functions found in nature is a grand challenge in protein design. Here we present protein diffusion transformer (ProDiT), a multimodal diffusion model that unifies sequence and structure modelling paradigms to enable the generation of proteins with computationally predicted functions at scale. Trained on sequences, three-dimensional structures and annotations for 128 million proteins across the evolutionary landscape, ProDiT generates diverse, novel proteins that are computationally predicted to preserve known active- and binding-site motifs and can be conditioned on a wide range of molecular functions, spanning 463 Gene Ontology terms. We introduce a diffusion sampling protocol to design proteins with multiple functional states, and illustrate this protocol by computationally scaffolding enzymatic active sites from carbonic anhydrase and lysozyme such that they are predicted to be deactivated by a calcium effector. Our results showcase the capacity of ProDiT to satisfy design specifications inaccessible to existing generative models, thereby expanding the protein design toolkit.
zh_abstract: 生成具备自然界中功能的全部多样性和复杂性的蛋白质，是蛋白质设计中的重大挑战。在此我们提出蛋白质扩散 Transformer（protein diffusion transformer，ProDiT），这是一种多模态扩散模型，统一了序列与结构建模范式，能够大规模生成经计算预测具有相应功能的蛋白质。ProDiT 在涵盖整个进化图谱的 1.28 亿个蛋白质的序列、三维结构和注释上训练，可生成多样且新颖的蛋白质，经计算预测这些蛋白质保留了已知的活性位点和结合位点基序，并可针对涵盖 463 个基因本体（Gene Ontology）术语的多种分子功能进行条件生成。我们引入了一种扩散采样方案，用于设计具有多种功能状态的蛋白质，并通过对碳酸酐酶和溶菌酶的酶活性位点进行计算支架设计来说明该方案，使其被预测可被钙效应物失活。我们的结果展示了 ProDiT 能够满足现有生成模型无法实现的设计要求，从而扩展了蛋白质设计工具箱。

title: Safety and accuracy diverge across deployment conditions in clinical large language models
zh_title: 临床大语言模型在不同部署条件下安全性与准确性出现分歧
summary: 提出SaFE-Scale框架与RadSaFE-200放射学基准，在六种部署条件下评估34个本地LLM，探讨准确率是否等同于安全性。
key_points: 200题放射学选择题，含临床医生定义的证据与高风险错误标签

abstract: Clinical large language models (LLMs) are commonly scaled by increasing model size, context length, retrieval complexity, or inference-time compute, on the assumption that higher accuracy implies safer behavior. In medicine, where a few confident or evidence-contradicting errors can outweigh average performance, this assumption may be incomplete. We introduce Safety-Focused Evaluation of Scaling (SaFE-Scale) and instantiate it on RadSaFE-200, a 200-question text-based radiology multiple-choice benchmark with clinician-defined clean evidence, conflict evidence, and option-level labels for high-risk error, unsafe answer, and evidence contradiction. Thirty-four local LLMs were evaluated across six deployment conditions spanning closed-book, evidence-grounded, standard and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and max-context prompting. Clean clinician-written evidence, used as an upper-bound, produced the strongest joint gain, raising mean accuracy from 73.5% to 94.1% and reducing high-risk error from 12.0% to 2.6% and dangerous overconfidence from 8.0% to 1.6%. Standard and agentic RAG, max-context prompting, and inference-time compute improved selected metrics but did not reproduce this safety profile. Clinically consequential errors concentrated in a small subset of questions, and variance decomposition placed deployment condition above model family on every safety metric. Within this evaluation, clinical LLM safety did not track accuracy scaling but emerged as a deployment-level property.
zh_abstract: 临床大语言模型（LLM）通常通过增加模型规模、上下文长度、检索复杂度或推理时计算量来扩展，其假设是更高的准确率意味着更安全的行为。在医学中，少数自信或与证据相矛盾的错误可能抵消平均表现，因此这一假设可能并不完整。我们提出了“以安全为中心的扩展评估”（SaFE-Scale），并在 RadSaFE-200 上实例化。RadSaFE-200 是一个包含200道文本型放射学多项选择题的基准，带有临床医生定义的干净证据、冲突证据，以及针对高风险错误、不安全答案和证据矛盾的选项级标签。我们在涵盖闭卷、基于证据、标准及智能体式检索增强生成（RAG）和最大上下文提示的六种部署条件下评估了34个本地 LLM。作为上限使用的临床医生撰写的干净证据带来了最强的联合提升，将平均准确率从73.5%提高到94.1%，将高风险错误从12.0%降至2.6%，将危险的过度自信从8.0%降至1.6%。标准和智能体式 RAG、最大上下文提示以及推理时计算量改善了部分指标，但未能复现这一安全性特征。具有临床后果的错误集中在一小部分问题上，方差分解显示，在每项安全指标上，部署条件的影响都高于模型家族。在本评估中，临床 LLM 的安全性并不随准确率的扩展而变化，而是表现为部署层面的属性。

abstract: [Radiology. Imaging cancer] Purpose To compare the diagnostic accuracy of artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated and standard mammography screening pathways for breast cancer detection using Bayesian network meta-analysis. Materials and Methods This prospectively registered review searched PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science through March 20, 2026, for diagnostic accuracy studies comparing two or more human-only or AI-integrated screening pathways using digital mammography or tomosynthesis. Bayesian bivariate random-effects network meta-analyses were fitted to a primary four-node and a secondary six-node network; risk of bias was assessed using the Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies 3 (QUADAS-3) and QUADAS-C tools, and certainty was graded using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation approach. Results Thirty-eight studies, with more than 4.2 million examinations, were included. In the primary digital mammography network (15 studies), AI as an independent reader (sensitivity, 78.9%; specificity, 95.8%) performed similarly to double human reading (sensitivity, 77.7%; specificity, 96.2%). In the secondary network, AI reader assistance had the highest sensitivity (86.8%) and AI triage had the highest specificity (96.4%). Per 10 000 screened (prevalence, 0.8%), AI reader assistance detected nine more cancers than single human reading (69 vs 60), with 77 additional false-positive recalls (558 vs 481); AI triage had 27% fewer false-positive recalls than single human reading (353 vs 481), with the same cancer detection as double human reading (64 vs 64). Stand-alone AI had the lowest specificity (93.0%) and the most false-positive recalls (n = 694). Rankings are hypothesis-generating: Top-ranked pathways had overlapping credible intervals. Conclusion In this synthesis, AI reader assistance was associated with the highest cancer detection and AI triage with the lowest false-positive recall; stand-alone AI was not supported as a primary screening strategy in settings with existing radiologist capacity. abstract: This manuscript describes a novel consumer-grade wearable approach, leveraging a self-supervised learning architecture for sports agnostic (basketball, running, soccer, and tennis) activity intensity features, that integrates with a heat balance approach to predict whole-body sweating rate. We collected whole-body sweating rates and analyzed data from 234 trials from 147 volunteers. Wet-bulb globe temperature ranged from 11 to 35 oC. Wearable triaxial accelerometry and chest-strap heart rate data were processed through a pretrained neural network to predict metabolic components for heat balance equations. For the independent validation set, the mean absolute error for predicted whole-body sweating rate was 0.08 L/h for basketball, 0.17 L/h for soccer, 0.00 L/h for tennis, 0.03 L/h for running with 0.03 L/h for all sports combined. The accounted-for variance (R2) for the whole-body sweating rate predictions were 0.76 for basketball, 0.73 for soccer, 0.82 for tennis, 0.94 for running and 0.79 for all sports combined. This study produced the following novel advancements: (1) first integration of wearable-derived activity features with a heat balance equation for sweat prediction; (2) first validated sport-agnostic wearable sweat prediction approach; and (3) first wearable method enabling a priori hydration management planning for exercise-heat stress conditions.

abstract: [Histopathology] Personalized medicine is on the rise, leading to increasingly granular treatment options. Consequently, pathologists are required to provide more detailed diagnoses to fully use the potential of these novel therapies. The number and complexity of grading systems and biomarker scoring methods are increasing. At the same time, the resulting rise in workload coincides with a growing shortage of pathologists, highlighting the need for new methods to ensure high-quality patient care in the future. This review explores the feasibility and readiness of artificial intelligence (AI) applications to alleviate routine diagnostic tasks in gastrointestinal (GI) pathology. It provides an organ-by-organ overview of both non-neoplastic and neoplastic diseases, with an emphasis on tools that show promise for direct or near-term clinical implementation. We found that numerous studies have investigated a wide range of diagnostic challenges, many of which have yielded encouraging results. While most tools remain in the research phase and often lack multicentre validation, commercially available AI solutions already exist for certain applications, in some cases even with regulatory approval for routine diagnostic use. In conclusion, most AI applications in GI pathology are still at a relatively early stage, and several challenges remain to be addressed. Nevertheless, many studies report promising results and suggest substantial advances in the near future. These developments have the potential to benefit both pathologists and patients by significantly expanding diagnostic capabilities while improving accuracy and reproducibility.
zh_abstract: [组织病理学] 个体化医疗日益兴起，使治疗选择越来越精细。因此，病理医师需要提供更详细的诊断，以充分发挥这些新型疗法的潜力。分级系统和生物标志物评分方法的数量和复杂性不断增加。与此同时，由此带来的工作量上升恰逢病理医师日益短缺，凸显出需要新的方法来确保未来的高质量患者诊疗。本综述探讨了人工智能（AI）应用于减轻胃肠道（GI）病理常规诊断任务的可行性和成熟度。文章按器官概述了非肿瘤性和肿瘤性疾病，重点关注有望直接或近期应用于临床的工具。我们发现，大量研究探讨了各种各样的诊断难题，其中许多取得了令人鼓舞的结果。尽管大多数工具仍处于研究阶段，且往往缺乏多中心验证，但某些应用已有市售的AI解决方案，部分甚至已获得用于常规诊断的监管批准。总之，GI病理中的大多数AI应用仍处于相对早期阶段，仍有若干挑战有待解决。尽管如此，许多研究报告了有前景的结果，并提示近期将取得重大进展。这些发展有望通过显著拓展诊断能力、同时提高准确性和可重复性，使病理医师和患者双方受益。

abstract: [Acta ophthalmologica] To investigate how artificial intelligence (AI) systems detect referable diabetic retinopathy (DR) from retinal photographs by analysing heatmap patterns and determining their overlap with DR features. Fifty-four AI systems were developed using 27 backbone architectures, with each implemented as both binary-referable and multi-class grading models based on the International Clinical Diabetic Retinopathy (ICDR) grading scale. Models were trained on DDR, BRSET and Kaggle datasets. After training, each model analysed 749 images with DR feature annotations, with Grad-CAM, Integrated Gradients, LIME and SHAP heatmaps generated and compared to pixel-level annotations of microaneurysms, haemorrhages, exudates, cotton wool spots, venous beading, intraretinal microvascular abnormalities and neovascularisation. All models achieved acceptable predictive performance (AUROC >0.8 for most architectures). Heatmap analysis revealed consistent attention to the central and temporal macular region. Exudates and cotton wool spots were highlighted most frequently by the heatmaps, with venous beading and neovascularisation at the disc showing poor overall coverage for binary referable classifiers. Models grading per the ICDR scale demonstrated higher coverage for all features. Substantial variability was observed between architectures, suggesting different feature detection capabilities. Interestingly, the heatmap analysis indicated that the models may be using different features to the ICDR grading scale definitions. AI models do not uniformly correlate with all DR features when detecting referable DR, limiting their predictive performance in unusual presentations. Heatmap aggregation analysis provides a scalable method for analysing model behaviour, allowing strengths and weaknesses to be assessed. These findings may help improve clinicians' trust and acceptance of AI.

abstract: Protein fitness landscapes are highly rugged, giving rise to complex optimization landscapes. Bayesian optimization (BO) with Gaussian processes (GPs) is widely used in protein engineering for its sample efficiency and calibrated uncertainty estimates. Here, we study a joint fine-tuning framework of a protein language model (PLM) and a GP across enzyme fitness landscapes that span various distinct mutation regimes encountered in real-world engineering campaigns. Joint fine-tuning optimizes the PLM and GP parameters together in an uncertainty-calibrated manner, providing an adaptive representation that utilizes the information from previously acquired points in addition to the existing knowledge from pretraining. Across seven combinatorial enzyme landscapes, this approach yields a median relative improvement in top-5% coverage of 45% over one-hot encoding and 120% over mean-pooled static ESM-C embeddings. We further explore several new pooling strategies beyond standard mean pooling within the joint fine-tuning framework and show that mutation-site pooling, which localizes the representation to mutated residues, is the most consistent performer across all landscapes, outperforming both established baselines and alternative pooling schemes. Finally, we show that the finetuned approach makes more effective use of training-split information, yielding better coverage across test-split BO rounds. These results suggest that adapting the representation during a campaign, rather than fixing it in advance, is the better design choice for BO-guided enzyme engineering.

abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) from primary care are scarce in low- and middle-income countries, and few have been made available to researchers in Latin America. We present DiabetIA, a longitudinal dataset derived from the primary care records of the Mexican Institute of Social Security (IMSS). The first release comprises 136,674 adults followed in six IMSS family medicine units in the state of Michoacan between 2005 and 2020, with more than 3.2 million visits summarized in 414,770 two-year windows with at least one visit. Each window includes demographics, ICD-10 diagnoses, anthropometry, vital signs, laboratory results and prescriptions, and type 2 diabetes diagnoses in the following year as prediction targets. At baseline, 24.4% of the patients had type 2 diabetes, 37.1% hypertension and 32.3% obesity. Technical validation assessed completeness, plausibility, consistency, temporal coverage and agreement with a state health survey. DiabetIA is freely available for download to support research on chronic disease trajectories and prediction in an underrepresented population.

abstract: [Pharmaceutics] Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have rendered mRNA therapeutics clinically viable, yet their design remains impeded by tightly intertwined chemical, physical, biological, and manufacturing variables. This review argues that artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted LNP design should be approached as multiscale therapeutic-system engineering rather than reduced to isolated predictive tasks. We propose that AI models must holistically integrate ionizable lipid chemistry, supramolecular assembly, protein corona remodeling, endosomal escape, organ- and cell-specific tropism, cargo attributes, safety profiles, and process robustness into a cohesive framework. Current studies demonstrate that machine learning can prioritize ionizable lipids, predict formulation properties, guide tissue-selective delivery, and expedite the design-build-test-learn cycle. However, many models remain constrained by insufficient sample sizes, poor in vitro/in vivo translation, reliance on random-split validation, and narrow potency-centric endpoints. We propose and apply a claim-specific evidence hierarchy for AI-LNP studies and propose standardized multimodal datasets, mechanism-informed descriptors, scaffold-level holdout tests, and manufacturability-aware objective functions. We conclude that digital models of LNP delivery must be treated as emerging hypotheses until anchored by prospective and clinically relevant evidence.

abstract: [Emergency radiology] Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming diagnostic radiology, yet its current clinical application in pediatric imaging remains fraught with challenges. Considerations that are unique to pediatric patients, including vast variations in developmental anatomy, age-specific disease patterns and pathologies, and technical variability create diagnostic challenges for which many commercially available AI systems, trained predominantly on adult data, are ill-equipped. This review utilizes literature evidence and illustrative clinical cases to critically examine various weaknesses of AI in pediatric imaging. Common pitfalls include misclassification of normal developmental variants, inability to distinguish pathological mimics, vulnerability to motion artifacts, modality-specific limitations, and errors introduced by artifacts or confounders. These failures are amplified by limited pediatric training data, annotation bias, and lack of contextual integration. We propose a structured framework for mitigating these risks, including pediatric-specific data curation, contextual model adaptation, algorithmic transparency, integrated feedback systems, technologist training, case-appropriate sedation planning, and centralized error tracking. These interventions are essential to enable safe, reliable, and ethically responsible AI deployment in pediatric emergency radiology.

abstract: [Journal of medical imaging and radiation oncology] Burnout is a major concern across medical professions, with radiologists and radiation oncologists among the most affected. Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to reduce burnout by decreasing workload; however, previous research has shown inconsistent associations between AI use and burnout. These relationships may depend on clinicians' motivation for using AI. A 6.5 min anonymous online survey was distributed to members of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists (RANZCR) over a 2 month period (May-July 2025). Measures included demographics and work-related variables (hours, level of training), burnout, AI use (frequency and task type), and motivation to use AI (based on Self-Determination Theory). Motivation was examined as a moderator of the relationship between AI use and burnout. Responses were received from 121 clinicians (90 radiologists, 31 radiation oncologists), including 21 trainees. Clinically significant burnout was reported by 42.1% (51/121) of respondents. Ninety-one (75.2%) respondents reported using AI, primarily for image analysis and interpretation (radiologists) and treatment planning (radiation oncologists). There was no overall significant relationship between AI use and burnout. However, AI use was positively associated with burnout among those reporting lower autonomy in AI use. This relationship was not mediated by need satisfaction or frustration. AI use is common among RANZCR members, and the burnout rate is prevalent. These preliminary findings highlight the potential importance of supporting autonomous motivation when implementing AI, while recognising that larger and more context-specific studies are required to confirm this relationship.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical imaging and radiation oncology] 职业倦怠是各医学专业普遍关注的问题，其中放射科医师和放射肿瘤科医师受影响最为严重。人工智能（AI）有可能通过减轻工作负担来缓解职业倦怠；然而，既往研究显示AI使用与职业倦怠之间的关联并不一致。这些关系可能取决于临床医师使用AI的动机。在为期2个月（2025年5月至7月）的时间内，向澳大利亚和新西兰皇家放射科医师学院（RANZCR）成员发放了一份耗时6.5分钟的匿名在线问卷。测量内容包括人口统计学和工作相关变量（工作时长、培训级别）、职业倦怠、AI使用情况（频率和任务类型），以及使用AI的动机（基于自我决定理论）。将动机作为AI使用与职业倦怠之间关系的调节变量进行检验。共收到121名临床医师的回复（90名放射科医师，31名放射肿瘤科医师），其中包括21名受训者。42.1%（51/121）的受访者报告存在具有临床意义的职业倦怠。91名（75.2%）受访者报告使用AI，主要用于图像分析和解读（放射科医师）以及治疗计划（放射肿瘤科医师）。AI使用与职业倦怠之间总体上无显著关联。然而，在报告AI使用自主性较低的人群中，AI使用与职业倦怠呈正相关。这一关系并未由需求满足或需求挫败所中介。AI在RANZCR成员中使用普遍，且职业倦怠发生率较高。这些初步发现凸显了在实施AI时支持自主性动机的潜在重要性，同时需认识到，仍需要更大规模且更具情境针对性的研究来证实这一关系。

abstract: [Clinical oral investigations] Although artificial intelligence has shown promise in detecting dental pathologies on radiographs, integrating these findings into patient-level disease profiles and caries risk stratification remains challenging. This study aimed to address this gap by combining automated radiographic analysis with fuzzy logic. YOLOv11 based models were trained to automatically detect teeth and pathological findings (caries, restorations, missing teeth) in panoramic radiographs. The DMFT (Decayed, Missing, Filled Teeth) score calculated from the detections and a single anamnesis question regarding the patient's previous treatment history were incorporated into a Mamdani-type fuzzy inference system to generate a quantitative risk score and corresponding risk category (low, medium, or high). The developed model was evaluated using clinical panoramic radiographs from 200 patients. The YOLOv11l model achieved a recall of 0.936 in pathology detection. The resulting classifications showed agreement rates of 92.5% and 92.0% with the American Dental Association (ADA) and Caries Management by Risk Assessment (CAMBRA) protocols, respectively. Cohen's kappa values exceeded 0.87. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of integrating radiographic detections and patient information into a structured patient-level assessment. The combination of automated image analysis and fuzzy logic provides a clinical decision-support framework for caries risk stratification based on panoramic radiographs. This approach offers an alternative way to integrate radiographic findings into a structured risk assessment process. The proposed system integrates automated radiographic analysis and risk stratification into routine dental assessment without requiring additional procedures. It can support clinical decision-making and facilitate communication with patients regarding oral health.

abstract: [Cancer control : journal of the Moffitt Cancer Center] Endometrial carcinoma is a common gynecological malignancy in developed countries, with its incidence continuing to rise. Myometrial invasion depth is a key prognostic factor and determinant of the 2023 International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) staging system, directly influencing surgical planning and adjuvant therapy. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) offers excellent soft tissue resolution, but conventional interpretation remains limited by subjectivity and inter-observer variability. Radiomics and deep learning have emerged as promising tools for preoperative assessment. In this narrative review, we synthesize evidence from MRI-based studies, covering T2-weighted imaging (T2WI), contrast-enhanced (CE) MRI, multi-sequence approaches, and comparisons with radiologist performance. Key challenges include overfitting, lack of external validation, reliance on manual annotation, and limited interpretability. Reported performance varied widely. A recent meta-analysis suggested that pooled areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) are lower than those reported in the best-performing single-center studies, raising generalizability concerns. This review critically appraises current evidence, compares artificial intelligence (AI) with radiologist performance, and outlines a roadmap toward clinical translation, including multi-center harmonization, automated workflows, and interpretability-by-design.

abstract: [Journal of clinical nursing] To explore how clinical nurses integrate generative artificial intelligence into nursing work, focusing on task support, perceived ability to verify outputs and professional responsibility. GenAI is increasingly used in nursing, but little is known about how nurses perceive their ability to verify outputs when task barriers are reduced, especially in evidence-sensitive or patient-related tasks. Between October and December 2025, a qualitative descriptive study was conducted in four tertiary hospitals in Nantong, China. Clinical nurses with experience of using GenAI were recruited using purposive maximum-variation sampling. Data were collected through individual semi-structured interviews and analysed using inductive thematic analysis. Data collection and analysis were conducted concurrently, with saturation assessed after 21 interviews and confirmed by one additional interview. Twenty-two clinical nurses were interviewed. Three themes and six subthemes were identified: (1) broadening GenAI use across nursing tasks, including progression from routine drafting to diverse nursing tasks and lowering task barriers; (2) the completion-verification gap, encompassing efficiency and learning support alongside superficial understanding and premature confidence; and (3) risk-calibrated integration, involving risk-based verification, retained professional responsibility and organisational safeguards. GenAI facilitated engagement with information-intensive and unfamiliar nursing tasks. However, easier task completion did not necessarily resolve perceived difficulties in identifying omissions, fabricated information or inappropriate recommendations. Safe integration therefore requires nurses to calibrate verification according to task risk, retain responsibility for final decisions and have access to organisational safeguards that support traceable and accountable use. Safe GenAI use in nursing requires risk-based verification, retained professional accountability and appropriate organisational safeguards. No patients or members of the public were involved because this study focused on clinical nurses' professional experiences.

abstract: [Pediatric radiology] The optimization of radiation dose in pediatric computed tomography (CT) is a critical imperative, driven by the heightened radiosensitivity of children. This review provides a critical analysis of the evolution of dose optimization, from foundational principles like As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA) and conventional techniques to the transformative impact of artificial intelligence (AI). We trace the progression from iterative reconstruction (IR), which offered initial dose reduction but was limited by unnatural image textures and computational demands, to the new paradigm of deep learning reconstruction (DLR) and emerging detector technologies like photon-counting CT. Clinical evidence demonstrates that DLR significantly shifts the traditional compromise between dose and image quality, enabling substantial potential dose reductions while producing images with superior noise properties and diagnostic confidence. Beyond reconstruction, AI is also automating scan protocoling to enhance consistency and reduce errors. However, the clinical integration of these powerful tools is not seamless. Significant barriers remain, including the "black box" nature of algorithms, the need for new training curricula for radiographers, and complex ethical and regulatory challenges. This review synthesizes these issues and charts a path forward, advocating for a holistic approach involving complementary AI-specific reference levels, federated learning, and robust governance to realize the full potential of a safer, more efficient, and patient-specific dose optimization ecosystem.

abstract: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is often under-documented in patients with cirrhosis, which delays treatment. Expert chart review of clinical notes can identify under-documented AUD, but is not scalable. We propose MedDx, an open-weight, training-free, and engine-agnostic language model, to phenotype AUD using clinical notes in patients with cirrhosis. We benchmarked MedDx on a 485-patient study cohort sampled from the 14,406-patient Indiana Cirrhosis Registry, using a chart-review-based reference as ground truth. MedDx agreed with the ground truth at three-class Cohen's {kappa} 0.92, against 0.67 for the AUD diagnosis code. It agreed with one hepatologist at 0.85 on all 485 charts and with a second at 0.82 on 186 charts, on which the two hepatologists agreed at 0.87. Weighted to the registry, its sensitivity was 98% and specificity 94%, against 63% and 96% for the AUD diagnosis code, and 61% of an estimated 6,223 patients with AUD had no AUD diagnosis by the first cirrhosis diagnosis. MedDx is openly available as an off-the-shelf, equitable, and auditable tool to identify AUD.

abstract: Panax ginseng C. A. Meyer is one of the most extensively studied medicinal plants, with substantial pharmaceutical and economic importance owing to its diverse bioactive constituents, particularly ginsenosides. Despite considerable advances in ginseng molecular research, the fragmentation of genomic, transcriptomic, protein structural, and biochemical information remains a major challenge for investigating gene function and specialized metabolism. abstract: Protein variant effect prediction (VEP) has a wide range of applications, from describing the role of mutations in human disease to improving enzymes for industrial applications. VEP is now predominantly powered by machine learning models and high-throughput experimentation. Progress in this field depends on fair and systematic model comparison, which is complicated by the heterogeneity of VEP tasks and the diversity of model implementations. ProteinGym is the most widely used VEP benchmark, but it does not have a standard representation for datasets or models. This makes it difficult for others to run their own benchmarks with it and for the benchmark to keep up with new datasets and models. We address these shortcomings with the ProteinGym framework (PGF), which standardizes dataset representations, model interfaces, and evaluation protocols. The PGF consists of two packages: proteingym-base, which provides schemas for composing datasets and the PGDATA archive format, a standardized representation of VEP datasets, and proteingym-benchmark, which provides automated benchmarking of containerized models. As an example of a new experiment, we use the PGF to measure the ability of three supervised models to identify variants with property values that exceed those in the training set, a common objective in protein engineering. The PGF is available at https://github.com/ProteinGym.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质变异效应预测（VEP）应用广泛，从阐明突变在人类疾病中的作用到改良工业用酶。目前 VEP 主要由机器学习模型和高通量实验驱动。该领域的进展依赖于公平、系统的模型比较，而 VEP 任务的异质性和模型实现的多样性使这一点变得复杂。ProteinGym 是使用最广泛的 VEP 基准，但它没有针对数据集或模型的标准表示方式。这使得其他人难以用它运行自己的基准测试，也使该基准难以跟上新数据集和新模型的步伐。我们提出 ProteinGym 框架（PGF）来解决这些不足，它对数据集表示、模型接口和评估方案进行了标准化。PGF 由两个软件包组成：proteingym-base 提供用于组合数据集的模式（schema）以及 PGDATA 归档格式（VEP 数据集的标准化表示）；proteingym-benchmark 则提供对容器化模型的自动化基准测试。作为一个新实验的示例，我们使用 PGF 衡量三种监督模型识别性质值超过训练集中数值的变异的能力，这是蛋白质工程中的常见目标。PGF 可在 https://github.com/ProteinGym 获取。

title: GRACE: Discrete Biological Sequence Optimization with Gradient-Resolved Adaptive Constrained Exploration
zh_title: GRACE：基于梯度解析自适应约束探索的离散生物序列优化
summary: 将序列重设计表述为约束优化，利用性质预测器梯度优化离散序列，在提升目标性质的同时约束辅助性质。
key_points: 以参考序列突变为基础的约束优化表述
通过直通估计器利用预测器梯度
兼顾酶活性与稳定性等多性质权衡
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见充分验证信息，值得一看档
abstract: Machine learning increasingly enables biological sequence redesign for therapeutic and biotechnological applications by optimizing sequences for desired properties. However, improving one property can compromise another: for example, increasing enzyme activity may reduce stability, while enhancing regulatory DNA activity may diminish cell-type specificity. We formulate sequence redesign as a constrained optimization problem guided by learned predictive models, where a reference sequence is mutated to improve a predicted target property while keeping predicted auxiliary properties within specified tolerances of their reference values. To solve this problem, we introduce GRACE (Gradient-Resolved Adaptive Constrained Exploration), a method that optimizes discrete biological sequences using gradients from property predictors via a straight-through estimator. GRACE combines two complementary mechanisms: null-space projection, which removes target-gradient components that interfere with active constraints, and an augmented Lagrangian mechanism, which encourages feasibility after constraint violations. We evaluate GRACE across fourteen diverse tasks, including six protein optimization tasks (spanning activity, stability, and solubility), five DNA tasks (spanning cell-type-specific enhancer activity, heat-shock-responsive promoters, and tissue-selective splicing), and three RNA design tasks (spanning translation efficiency, RNA folding, and toehold-switch function). Across these tasks, GRACE consistently achieves larger improvements in predicted target properties than discrete and continuous baselines while satisfying predicted auxiliary constraints. Together, these results establish GRACE as a general framework for machine-learning-guided biological sequence redesign under competing property constraints.

title: Reproducible variability: assessing human vs. AI discordance in attempting to reproduce the same observational study
zh_title: 可复现的变异性：人类与AI复现同一观察性研究的差异
summary: 在3590万患者的理赔数据库上，比较9个人类团队与AI智能体复现同一GLP-1受体激动剂队列定义的一致性。
key_points: 共27次独立复现，分三组
AI智能体与9个已发表人类定义对照
所有组使用相同冻结代码集
reason: 设计有新意的预印本，有人机对照，但结果未完整给出
abstract: Objective: Previously, nine expert teams given a published study and identical code sets produced nine substantially different cohorts, prompting the conclusion that analytic code cannot be reliably generated from natural-language description. We tested whether an artificial intelligence (AI) agent, given that same description, reproduces a cohort definition more faithfully and consistently than those teams. Materials and Methods: Against a claims database of 35.9 million patients, we executed 27 independent reproductions of that published glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist cohort definition: the nine published human definitions re-implemented deterministically (Arm A); nine independent AI agent runs given the source paper as published (Arm B); and nine given a rewrite that removed its internal contradictions (Arm C). All arms received identical frozen code sets. Agreement with a reference cohort was quantified by the Jaccard index. Results: Agents in Arm B achieved a median Jaccard index of 0.450 versus 0.259 for the human definitions, median pairwise agreement of 0.492 versus 0.149, and a 5.06-fold versus 32.0-fold size spread. Agent variation resolved almost entirely onto two criteria reported differently in the source main text and supplement. In Arm C, median agreement and median pairwise agreement both reached 1.000. Discussion: Changing only the analyst strongly trended towards improvement in fidelity, with every agent run more self-consistent than every human team. Changing the specification resulted in exact fidelity and self-consistency. Irreproducibility arose from both specification quality and inter-analyst variation. Conclusion: AI agents were more consistent than human teams when translating published natural-language descriptions into code.
zh_abstract: 【目的】此前，九个专家团队在获得同一篇已发表研究和相同代码集的情况下，生成了九个差异显著的队列，由此得出结论：分析代码无法可靠地由自然语言描述生成。我们检验了人工智能（AI）智能体在获得同样描述时，是否比这些团队更忠实、更一致地重现队列定义。【材料与方法】在一个包含3590万名患者的医保理赔数据库中，我们对该已发表的胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂队列定义执行了27次独立复现：对九个已发表的人工定义进行确定性重新实现（A组）；九次独立的AI智能体运行，输入为已发表原文（B组）；以及九次输入为消除了内部矛盾的改写版本（C组）。所有组均使用相同的冻结代码集。以Jaccard指数量化与参考队列的一致性。【结果】B组智能体的Jaccard指数中位数为0.450，人工定义为0.259；两两一致性中位数分别为0.492和0.149；队列规模差异倍数分别为5.06倍和32.0倍。智能体之间的差异几乎完全归结于原文正文与补充材料中报告不一致的两项标准。在C组中，一致性中位数和两两一致性中位数均达到1.000。【讨论】仅更换分析者即呈现出明显的忠实度提升趋势，每一次智能体运行的自洽性都高于每一个人工团队。更换规范说明则实现了完全的忠实度和自洽性。不可复现性既源于规范说明的质量，也源于分析者之间的差异。【结论】在将已发表的自然语言描述转化为代码时，AI智能体比人工团队更为一致。

title: How many large language models does title-abstract screening need? Theory, two replications and an evaluation at real prevalence
zh_title: 标题摘要筛选需要多少个大语言模型？理论、两次复现及真实患病率评估
summary: 用β-二项模型估计LLM集成规模，在SYNERGY与Cochrane综述上推导并复现，评估带仲裁者的双投票流程。
key_points: 11个LLM在13个SYNERGY综述上投票推导
在10个和16个Cochrane综述上复现预设预测
在真实患病率下评估双投票加仲裁流程
reason: 方法有新意、含独立复现，但为预印本且应用偏文献筛选
abstract: Background and Objectives: Researchers increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) to screen titles and abstracts, assuming that more models make screening safer. We estimated how many models a screening ensemble needs, given correlated errors, and tested the answer on independent reviews and at real prevalence. Methods: We modelled correlated votes with a beta-binomial model and estimated, by bootstrap, the smallest ensemble capturing 95% of the net-benefit gain attainable over the best single model, accounting for human reading time and machine cost. Eleven LLMs from four developers voted blind on records from 13 SYNERGY reviews (derivation). We tested predictions fixed in advance on 10 and 16 Cochrane reviews from a public screening benchmark (replications) and evaluated a two-voter pipeline with an adjudicator on 11 complete benchmark collections and six reviews published in 2026. Results: Errors on relevant records were correlated (intraclass correlation 0.56 among eight different models; 0.75-0.78 among roles or copies of one model): eight models carried the information of about 1.6 independent ones. In derivation, the best single model, pair and trio reached sensitivities of 0.920, 0.975 and 0.981. Three or fewer models captured 95% of the attainable gain in at least 86%, 88% and 80.8% of bootstrap replicates of every scenario in the derivation set and the two replications, respectively. Six of seven registered predictions held in replication 1 and three of five sealed predictions in replication 2, where a fourth model added 2.1 percentage points to trios on average but 0.3 to the best trio. At real prevalence, the pipeline sent 94 of 96 included studies to human reading in the benchmark collections and 163 of 178 in the 2026 reviews (12.1% of 12,196 records sent to reading); its more sensitive voter alone sent 259 of 274 with 12.0%, at under a quarter of the machine cost. Conclusion: Because LLM errors are correlated, our results suggest two or three well-chosen models may suffice, but this needs deeper exploration in future studies. Which models are combined and how matter as much as how many, and any ensemble should be compared with its best single member.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】研究者越来越多地组合使用大语言模型（LLM）筛选标题和摘要，认为模型越多筛选越安全。我们在误差相关的前提下估计筛选集成需要多少个模型，并在独立综述和真实患病率（纳入比例）条件下检验这一答案。【方法】我们用贝塔-二项模型对相关投票建模，并通过自助法（bootstrap）估计在考虑人工阅读时间和机器成本的情况下，能够获得相对于最佳单一模型可达净获益增量95%的最小集成规模。来自四家开发者的11个LLM对13篇SYNERGY综述中的记录进行盲法投票（推导）。我们在公开筛选基准的10篇和16篇Cochrane综述上检验了事先确定的预测（复制验证），并在11个完整的基准集合和2026年发表的六篇综述上评估了带有裁决者的双投票者流程。【结果】相关记录上的误差存在相关性（八个不同模型间的组内相关系数为0.56；同一模型的不同角色或副本间为0.75–0.78）：八个模型所含信息约相当于1.6个独立模型。在推导中，最佳单一模型、两模型组合和三模型组合的敏感度分别为0.920、0.975和0.981。在推导集及两项复制验证中，每种情景下分别至少有86%、88%和80.8%的自助复制样本中，三个或更少的模型即可获得可达增益的95%。复制验证1中七项登记预测有六项成立，复制验证2中五项封存预测有三项成立；其中第四个模型平均使三模型组合提高2.1个百分点，但使最佳三模型组合仅提高0.3个百分点。在真实患病率下，该流程在基准集合中将96项纳入研究中的94项送入人工阅读，在2026年综述中将178项中的163项送入人工阅读（12,196条记录中12.1%被送去阅读）；其中较敏感的单个投票者单独使用时，274项中送入259项，比例为12.0%，机器成本不到四分之一。【结论】由于LLM误差存在相关性，我们的结果提示两到三个精心选择的模型可能已足够，但这需要在未来研究中进一步深入探讨。组合哪些模型以及如何组合，与组合多少个模型同样重要，任何集成都应与其最佳单一成员进行比较。

title: HapAdapter: A Transfer Learning Protocol for DNA Foundation Models Adapted to Diploid Personal Epigenomes
zh_title: HapAdapter：将DNA基础模型适配二倍体个人表观基因组的迁移学习方案
summary: 针对现有DNA基础模型仅用单倍体参考基因组训练的局限，提出迁移学习协议以适配二倍体个人基因组。
key_points: 现有模型仅基于单倍体参考基因组训练
为个人基因组与图基因组场景提供适配
采用迁移学习降低训练成本
reason: 有新意的基础模型适配方法，预印本，证据细节有限
abstract: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) has spurred the development of genomic language models (gLMs) that capitalize on the key features of natural language present in biological sequences. Moreover, DNA foundation models, a sub-class of gLMs, have demonstrated impressive accuracy in predicting a wide range of functional tracks from DNA sequence input. However, current DNA foundation models are exclusively trained on haploid reference genome sequences -- despite personal and graph genomes becoming the new standard for genomic analyses. This is principally because the cost to train gLMs on a personal diploid genome for a single individual is not currently practical. To help reconcile this disconnect between the current available use-cases of DNA foundation models with the modern direction of genomic sequence analysis, we present HapAdapter, a transfer-learning protocol that builds a small Siamese network on top of any pre-trained foundation model to enable inference from full diploid personal genome context. To demonstrate the utility of this method, we train a set of HapAdapter heads to predict allele-specific effects across assays on two representative foundation model backbones: DNABERT-2 and AlphaGenome. We demonstrate that our lightweight adapter more than doubles DNABERT-2's allele-specific discrimination and triples AlphaGenome's (130% and 210% gain in AUROC above chance, respectively, averaged over nine assays).
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的迅速兴起推动了基因组语言模型（gLM）的发展，这类模型利用了生物序列中存在的自然语言的关键特征。此外，DNA 基础模型作为 gLM 的一个子类，已在根据 DNA 序列输入预测多种功能轨迹方面展现出令人印象深刻的准确性。然而，目前的 DNA 基础模型仅在单倍体参考基因组序列上训练，尽管个人基因组和图基因组正成为基因组分析的新标准。这主要是因为针对单个个体的个人二倍体基因组训练 gLM 的成本目前并不现实。为了弥合 DNA 基础模型现有应用场景与基因组序列分析现代发展方向之间的这一脱节，我们提出了 HapAdapter，这是一种迁移学习方案，可在任意预训练基础模型之上构建一个小型孪生网络（Siamese network），从而实现基于完整二倍体个人基因组背景的推断。为展示该方法的实用性，我们在两个具有代表性的基础模型骨干——DNABERT-2 和 AlphaGenome——上训练了一组 HapAdapter 头部，用于预测跨多种检测的等位基因特异性效应。结果表明，我们的轻量级适配器使 DNABERT-2 的等位基因特异性区分能力提高了一倍以上，使 AlphaGenome 的提高了两倍（在九种检测上平均，AUROC 高于随机水平的增幅分别为 130% 和 210%）。

title: Capturing human expertise for AI-assisted molecular structure annotation
zh_title: 捕获专家经验的LLM工具辅助胆汁酸结构注释
summary: 研究开发基于大语言模型的工具，利用手写笔记、文献和语音转写记录捕获专家推理，生成可追溯的胆汁酸结构解析报告。
key_points: 整合笔记、文献与语音转文字分析记录
报告列出支持与反对候选结构的证据并追溯来源
可为缺乏参考谱图的胆汁酸结合物提出候选
reason: 预印本，LLM用于生物医学发现有新意，但验证信息有限
abstract: We developed a large language model-based tool that captures expert reasoning in bile acid structure elucidation, drawing on hand written notebooks, scientific literature, and recorded voice-to-text analytical sessions. It generates human-readable reports detailing evidence for and against candidate structures, tracing each inference to its source and identifying ambiguities. When applied to data, the tool proposes bile acid conjugates lacking reference spectra.

title: RBAi Scholar: Semantic and Hybrid biomedical literature Search for Researchers and AI assistants
zh_title: RBAi Scholar：面向研究者与AI助手的语义/混合生物医学文献检索
summary: 该工具支持语义、关键词与混合检索，在1110万条摘要上测试，500个改写问题中语义检索top10命中率65.0%，高于LitSense 2.0和PubMed。
key_points: 语义检索top10命中65.0%
对比LitSense 2.0为18.6%、PubMed为0.8%
OpenAlex语义检索为27.8%，重建后45.8%
reason: 有基线对比的检索工具预印本，非临床场景
abstract: Motivation: A keyword search for mitochondrial dysfunction can miss a paper that says impaired mitochondrial function, so an empty result does not show that no such paper exists. Search by meaning addresses this mismatch, but it blurs exact strings such as gene symbols. Results: We present RBAi Scholar, which lets researchers and AI assistants search a growing corpus of biomedical abstracts by meaning (semantic search), by keyword, or by meaning among the papers that contain a required term (hybrid search). We tested it on a fixed version of 11.1 million records. For 500 questions worded unlike their target papers, semantic search placed the target in the top ten for 65.0%, against 18.6% for LitSense 2.0 and 0.8% for PubMed. OpenAlex semantic search, documented as using GTE-Large-EN embeddings, reached 27.8%. It reached 45.8% after OpenAlex rebuilt it with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, the model RBAi Scholar uses. Semantic search also led on the 380 held-out targets, which played no part in its design. Given one required term from the paper, hybrid search reached 93.9% on 328 held-out targets, against 42.1% for LitSense 2.0 with the same term. For 86 queries made of a paper's rarest identifier, such as a gene symbol, and two title words, keyword search reached 79.1%, against 34.9% for semantic search. When a blinded language-model judge graded the relevance of each system's top ten results, semantic search returned the most relevant results (nDCG@10 0.651 against 0.592 for OpenAlex semantic search with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B). Hybrid search ranked the target first more than twice as often as semantic search (50.0% against 23.3%). When we re-ran the searches for target papers on two cheaper index implementations and on the live service at 24.6 million records, every comparison kept its direction.
zh_abstract: 【动机】针对线粒体功能障碍（mitochondrial dysfunction）的关键词检索可能会漏掉写作“impaired mitochondrial function”的论文，因此检索结果为空并不能说明不存在此类论文。按语义检索可以解决这种不匹配，但会模糊基因符号等精确字符串。【结果】我们提出 RBAi Scholar，它使研究人员和 AI 助手能够按语义（语义检索）、按关键词，或在含有必需检索词的论文中按语义（混合检索）检索不断增长的生物医学摘要语料库。我们在包含 1110 万条记录的固定版本上对其进行了测试。对于 500 个措辞与目标论文不同的问题，语义检索使目标论文进入前十位的比例为 65.0%，而 LitSense 2.0 为 18.6%，PubMed 为 0.8%。据文档记载使用 GTE-Large-EN 嵌入的 OpenAlex 语义检索达到 27.8%；在 OpenAlex 改用 RBAi Scholar 所用模型 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 重建后，达到 45.8%。语义检索在 380 个未参与其设计的留出目标上同样领先。在给定论文中的一个必需检索词的情况下，混合检索在 328 个留出目标上达到 93.9%，而使用同一检索词的 LitSense 2.0 为 42.1%。对于由论文最罕见的标识符（如基因符号）和两个标题词构成的 86 个查询，关键词检索达到 79.1%，语义检索为 34.9%。当由盲法语言模型评判者对各系统前十位结果的相关性进行评分时，语义检索返回的相关结果最多（nDCG@10 为 0.651，而使用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 的 OpenAlex 语义检索为 0.592）。混合检索将目标排在第一位的频率是语义检索的两倍多（50.0% 对 23.3%）。当我们在两种成本更低的索引实现以及包含 2460 万条记录的在线服务上重新运行针对目标论文的检索时，所有比较的方向均保持不变。

title: Resplitting LIT-PCBA with MolSCISSOR: A Memory-Efficient, Quasi-Deterministic Framework for Reducing Structural and Physicochemical Biases
zh_title: MolSCISSOR：重新划分LIT-PCBA以减少结构与理化偏倚
summary: 提出轻量、省内存、准确定性的分层数据划分框架MolSCISSOR，通过聚类与多目标优化重新划分LIT-PCBA虚拟筛选基准。
key_points: 针对跨分区结构偏倚与类间理化偏倚
聚类结合训练-测试分配的多目标优化
用于重划分含15个靶点数据集的LIT-PCBA
reason: 有新意的基准划分方法，预印本，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Reliable training-test partitioning is essential for developing and evaluating virtual screening (VS) methods, particularly in the era of machine learning (ML). However, existing molecular dataset splitting approaches do not simultaneously address key challenges in rigorous VS evaluation: cross-partition structural bias, test-set inter-class physicochemical bias, high memory requirements, limited scalability, stochastic allocation, a lack of automated optimization and of flexible training-test similarity control. We introduce MolSCISSOR, a lightweight, memory-efficient, quasi-deterministic framework for stratified data partitioning that integrates clustering and training-test allocation through multi-objective optimization. MolSCISSOR is used to repartition LIT-PCBA, a well-established VS benchmark comprising 15 target-specific datasets of experimentally confirmed actives and inactives, exhibiting substantial class imbalance, many of which are large-scale. We show that simple baseline ML models achieve significantly above-chance screening performance on the original AVE-derived partitions, indicating residual biases. The MolSCISSOR-generated benchmark, SPLIT-PCBA, is more challenging than both the AVE variant and that obtained using a BitBIRCH-Lean clustering-based workflow, with stricter cross-partition structural separation and improved physicochemical balance between test-set actives and inactives. MolSCISSOR mitigates stochastic variability, requires less memory than AVE, Lo-Hi and DataSAIL, and supports multiple split configurations with varying cross-partition similarity. MolSCISSOR and SPLIT-PCBA are freely available at https://github.com/caominhtr/molscissor and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23942580.
zh_abstract: 可靠的训练集-测试集划分对于开发和评估虚拟筛选（VS）方法至关重要，在机器学习（ML）时代尤其如此。然而，现有的分子数据集划分方法无法同时解决严格评估VS所面临的关键挑战：跨分区结构偏倚、测试集类间理化性质偏倚、高内存需求、可扩展性有限、随机分配、缺乏自动化优化以及缺乏灵活的训练集-测试集相似性控制。我们提出了MolSCISSOR，这是一种轻量级、内存高效、准确定性的分层数据划分框架，通过多目标优化将聚类与训练集-测试集分配整合在一起。我们使用MolSCISSOR对LIT-PCBA进行重新划分；LIT-PCBA是一个成熟的VS基准，包含15个靶点特异性数据集，其中含经实验确认的活性分子和非活性分子，类别严重不平衡，且其中许多数据集规模较大。我们发现，简单的基线ML模型在源自AVE的原始划分上取得了显著高于随机水平的筛选性能，提示存在残余偏倚。由MolSCISSOR生成的基准SPLIT-PCBA比AVE版本以及采用基于BitBIRCH-Lean聚类的工作流程所得到的版本更具挑战性，其跨分区结构分离更严格，测试集中活性分子与非活性分子之间的理化性质平衡也得到改善。MolSCISSOR减轻了随机变异性，所需内存低于AVE、Lo-Hi和DataSAIL，并支持具有不同跨分区相似性的多种划分配置。MolSCISSOR和SPLIT-PCBA可免费获取，网址为 https://github.com/caominhtr/molscissor 和 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23942580。

title: FunDLM: A Foundation DNA Language Model for Fungi
zh_title: FunDLM：面向真菌的基础DNA语言模型
summary: 预印本在426个真菌参考基因组上预训练DNA语言模型，零样本区分酿酒酵母表型相关错义变异，AUROC为0.875。
key_points: 预训练覆盖217个属、14.3 Gb序列
性能与参数约15倍的Evo 2相当
优于Nucleotide Transformer v3
reason: 领域专用基础模型有基线对比，但为预印本且非临床
abstract: Background: Fungi are important pathogens and biotechnology resources, but lack a broadly applicable fungal DNA language model. Models trained on diverse fungal genomes can support functional interpretation of genomic variants and a broad range of genomic tasks. Results: We introduce FunDLM, a family of four DNA language models pre-trained on 426 fungal reference assemblies spanning 217 genera and 14.3 Gb of sequence. Without task-specific training, FunDLM-Medium-1024bp distinguished phenotype-associated missense variants of Saccharomyces cerevisiae from synonymous controls with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.875. It performed comparably to Evo 2, a generalist model with about 15 times more parameters, and better than Nucleotide Transformer v3. The model also recognized mutations that disrupt start codons or introduce premature stop codons in S. cerevisiae and the blast fungus Pyricularia oryzae. Its scores for missense variants, computed from DNA alone, correlated with those of protein language models in S. cerevisiae and two Fusarium species (Pearson correlation 0.57-0.75). After fine-tuning, FunDLM-Small-1024bp identified supernumerary chromosome sequences in four Pyricularia isolates not used for training (average precision 0.884), and FunDLM-Medium-1024bp recognized centromeres on a chromosome withheld from training (AUROC 0.908). Fine-tuned models also predicted three histone modifications in an isolate and on chromosomes not used for training (AUROC 0.910-0.996). Conclusions: FunDLM provides reusable sequence representations for assessing functional impacts of fungal variants as well as annotation of genomic and epigenomic features. The released models, data, code, and benchmarks support applications across fungal species.
zh_abstract: 【背景】真菌是重要的病原体和生物技术资源，但缺乏广泛适用的真菌 DNA 语言模型。基于多样化真菌基因组训练的模型可支持基因组变异的功能解读以及多种基因组任务。【结果】我们提出了 FunDLM，这是一个由四个 DNA 语言模型组成的系列，在涵盖 217 个属、共 14.3 Gb 序列的 426 个真菌参考基因组组装上进行了预训练。在未经任务特异性训练的情况下，FunDLM-Medium-1024bp 区分酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中与表型相关的错义变异与同义对照的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为 0.875。其表现与参数量约为其 15 倍的通用模型 Evo 2 相当，并优于 Nucleotide Transformer v3。该模型还能识别酿酒酵母和稻瘟病菌（Pyricularia oryzae）中破坏起始密码子或引入提前终止密码子的突变。其仅根据 DNA 计算得到的错义变异评分，在酿酒酵母和两种镰刀菌（Fusarium）中与蛋白质语言模型的评分相关（Pearson 相关系数 0.57–0.75）。经过微调后，FunDLM-Small-1024bp 在四个未用于训练的 Pyricularia 分离株中识别出了额外染色体（supernumerary chromosome）序列（平均精度 0.884），FunDLM-Medium-1024bp 在一条未用于训练的染色体上识别出着丝粒（AUROC 0.908）。微调后的模型还在未用于训练的分离株和染色体上预测了三种组蛋白修饰（AUROC 0.910–0.996）。【结论】FunDLM 提供了可重复使用的序列表征，可用于评估真菌变异的功能影响，以及注释基因组和表观基因组特征。所发布的模型、数据、代码和基准可支持跨真菌物种的应用。

title: Task-aligned foundation model representations enable single-cell cytokine response inference
zh_title: CYTAP：基于基础模型表示的单细胞细胞因子响应推断
summary: 预印本提出CYTAP，将冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入与匹配对照偏差结合，用于90种细胞因子的单细胞响应评分，并在独立扰动数据集中验证。
key_points: 适配State SE与scFoundation冻结嵌入
基线相对表示提升留出供体预测
在独立体内数据集中将所施因子排入前十
reason: 单细胞基础模型新方法，独立数据集验证，预印本
abstract: Inferring cellular responses from single-cell transcriptomes requires interpreting changes relative to an appropriate baseline while retaining cell-type context. Here we present CYTAP, which adapts frozen single-cell foundation model embeddings for cytokine-response inference by combining donor-adjusted receiver states with deviations from matched control centroids. CYTAP uses a shared classifier to assign relative single-cell response scores across 90 cytokines and supports unpaired analyses using counterfactual control references. Baseline-relative representations improved held-out-donor prediction with both State SE and scFoundation. Across independent perturbation datasets, CYTAP prioritized applied cytokines, including when receptor transcripts were sparsely detected, and ranked administered cytokines among the top ten in both in vivo datasets. In an unpaired COVID-19 cohort, inferred responses were associated with severity, and IL-6 response scores correlated with plasma IL-6 concentrations. These findings support the use of biologically defined references to adapt pretrained representations for functional response inference.
zh_abstract: 从单细胞转录组推断细胞反应，需要在保留细胞类型背景的同时，相对于合适的基线来解读变化。在此，我们提出 CYTAP，它通过将经供体校正的受体状态与相对于匹配对照质心的偏离相结合，使冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入适用于细胞因子反应推断。CYTAP 使用共享分类器为 90 种细胞因子分配相对的单细胞反应评分，并借助反事实对照参照支持非配对分析。基线相对表征在 State SE 和 scFoundation 两种模型上均改善了留出供体的预测。在多个独立的扰动数据集中，CYTAP 能够优先识别所施加的细胞因子，即使在受体转录本检测稀疏时亦然，并且在两个体内数据集中均将所给予的细胞因子排在前十位。在一个非配对的 COVID-19 队列中，推断出的反应与疾病严重程度相关，且 IL-6 反应评分与血浆 IL-6 浓度相关。这些发现支持利用生物学定义的参照来调整预训练表征，以进行功能反应推断。

title: Confident but misplaced: a model-free ruler for post-translational modification placement by AI structure predictors
zh_title: 自信但错位：AI结构预测器翻译后修饰位置的无模型标尺
summary: 预印本以晶体结构构建标尺，评估RareFold、Boltz-2、Chai-1、AlphaFold 3对176个留出PTM位点的预测，发现新增原子位置误差较大。
key_points: 氧化Cys/Met新增氧原子误差1.19-1.51 Å
邻近标准侧链原子误差仅0.35-0.38 Å
测试位点发布于各模型训练截止之后
reason: 设计严谨的结构预测评测，但为预印本，证据有限
abstract: AI structure predictors accept post-translationally modified (PTM) residues, but whether they place the added atoms where crystallography finds them, and whether their confidence reveals when they do not, is unknown. We first built a ruler from experiment alone: independent crystal structures of the same site reproduce the added atoms of oxidised cysteine and methionine to 0.32 [A], the closest pre-cutoff library rotamer lies at 0.41 [A] and a model-free guess at 4.17 [A]. We then predicted 176 hold-out PTM sites, released after every model's training cut-off, with RareFold, Boltz-2, Chai-1 and AlphaFold 3, using identical inputs and thresholds fixed before measurement. On oxidised Cys/Met (up to 34 sites in 25 proteins), the three all-atom models place the matching distal atoms of neighbouring canonical side chains to 0.35-0.38 [A] but the added oxygens at 1.19-1.51 [A]; 29-41 % of placements are wrong by more than 2 [A], as sterically plausible rotamers that the electron density does not support. RareFold misplaces ordinary side chains as well. Across all PTM classes, residue confidence does not flag the failure: at pLDDT [≥] 90, 24-46 % of modified-residue placements are catastrophic, 3.5-5 times the rate for matched canonical atoms. One seed rarely samples the correct rotamer; more seeds sample it more often, yet the models' own ranking does not select it. Methyllysine shows the same gap, whereas for pyridoxal-lysine the models diverge (AlphaFold 3 1.13 [A], Boltz-2 4.96 [A]). A high residue pLDDT at a modified residue therefore does not verify its side chain.
zh_abstract: AI 结构预测器可以接受翻译后修饰（PTM）残基，但它们是否会把新增原子放在晶体学所观察到的位置，以及其置信度能否提示何时没有做到，目前尚不清楚。我们首先仅依据实验数据建立了一把“标尺”：同一位点的独立晶体结构，对氧化半胱氨酸和甲硫氨酸新增原子位置的重现精度为 0.32 Å；截止日期前最接近的库旋转异构体距离为 0.41 Å，无模型的猜测则为 4.17 Å。随后，我们使用 RareFold、Boltz-2、Chai-1 和 AlphaFold 3，以相同的输入和测量前固定的阈值，预测了 176 个留出的 PTM 位点，这些位点均在所有模型的训练截止日期之后发布。在氧化 Cys/Met 上（25 个蛋白中最多 34 个位点），三个全原子模型对相邻标准侧链对应远端原子的位置预测误差为 0.35–0.38 Å，但新增氧原子的位置误差为 1.19–1.51 Å；29–41% 的放置偏差超过 2 Å，表现为电子密度并不支持的、空间位阻上合理的旋转异构体。RareFold 对普通侧链的放置也有误。在所有 PTM 类别中，残基置信度并不能提示这种失败：在 pLDDT ≥ 90 时，24–46% 的修饰残基放置属于灾难性错误，是匹配的标准原子错误率的 3.5–5 倍。单个随机种子很少能采样到正确的旋转异构体；种子越多，采样到的频率越高，但模型自身的排序并不能将其选出。甲基赖氨酸表现出同样的差距，而对于吡哆醛-赖氨酸，各模型之间存在分歧（AlphaFold 3 为 1.13 Å，Boltz-2 为 4.96 Å）。因此，修饰残基处较高的残基 pLDDT 并不能证明其侧链预测正确。

title: Automated Trimodal Deep Learning Fusion of MRI, CT, and Endoscopy for Preoperative Differentiation of Sinonasal Inverted Papilloma and Malignant Transformation.
zh_title: MRI、CT与内镜三模态深度学习融合鉴别鼻腔内翻性乳头状瘤恶变
summary: 回顾性研究纳入849例患者，构建自动化三模态融合框架，用于术前区分鼻腔内翻性乳头状瘤与其恶变鳞癌。

单模态ResNet以743例不完整模态数据训练

reason: 回顾性、融合评估样本仅106例，无明确外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] Purpose: To develop and validate an automated trimodal deep learning fusion framework integrating magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), and nasal endoscopy for preoperative differentiation between sinonasal inverted papilloma (SIP) and SIP-transformed squamous cell carcinoma (SIP-SCC). Materials and Methods: This retrospective study included 849 patients with pathological diagnoses of SIP (n = 614) or SIP-SCC (n = 235) between October 2014 and August 2025. Three unimodal ResNet-based deep learning models were trained and validated using data from 743 patients with only one or two modalities. The trained networks then generated MRI, CT, and endoscopy probability scores for each of 106 separate patients with complete trimodal data. These scores were combined using logistic regression, with fusion performance assessed by five-fold cross-validation in the 106-patient cohort. In the reader study, its performance was compared with six physicians (three junior, three senior). Results: The trimodal fusion model achieved an out-of-fold AUC of 0.910. Its AUC was higher than that of CT (0.634; unadjusted p < 0.001; Holm-adjusted p < 0.001) and endoscopy (0.813; unadjusted p = 0.023; Holm-adjusted p = 0.045), but the difference from MRI (0.859; unadjusted and adjusted p = 0.142) was not statistically significant. At the fixed threshold of 0.5, the fusion model achieved an accuracy of 83.0%. Accuracy differed significantly between the fusion model and the junior-reader group majority vote (64.2%; unadjusted p = 0.004; adjusted p = 0.022), but not the senior-reader group majority vote (81.1%; unadjusted p = 0.860; adjusted p = 1.000). Conclusions: By integrating MRI, CT, and endoscopy images, the trimodal fusion model achieved the highest AUC among the evaluated models for differentiating SIP from SIP-SCC, suggesting its potential value as a clinical decision support tool.

abstract: Automated twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation has historically relied on discriminative classifiers limited to closed-set diagnostic labels, signal reconstruction, or saliency heatmaps. While categorizing predefined arrhythmias well, these static classifiers cannot generate narrative clinical reports, incorporate patient history, or support interactive clinical question-answering (Q&A). We present LifeLine.ai, an end-toend multimodal Vision-ECG-Language framework for automated cardiac diagnosis and clinical reporting. After early attempts at waveform peak-tracking and coordinate mapping failed against complex morphological variations, we leveraged large-scale PhysioNet repositories (MIMIC-IV and PTB-XL). Because hardware limits precluded training on over 800,000 raw records, we curated a balanced subset to estimate performance, converting one-dimensional signals into 3x4 twelve-lead grids with continuous Lead II rhythm strips at the bottom. Our pipeline integrates YOLOv11s localization, a LoRAadapted Google SigLIP encoder, a trainable Multi-Layer Perceptron projector, and a 4-bit quantized MedGemma-4B model, complemented by a separate Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO) pipeline built on collected user feedback and a multi-LLM consensus engine. On this compact subset, SigLIP outperformed Swin Transformer encodings (~0.21 vs. ~0.25 validation loss), achieving 71.0% open-vocabulary precision and a 75.0% contextual F1 score across a cloud deployment spanning Vercel, mobile apps, Amazon EC2, Firebase, Hugging Face, Modal GPUs, and lifelinecg-sdk. Our code is available at https://github.com/Asad939asad/ LifeLine.ai-.
zh_abstract: 自动化十二导联心电图（ECG）解读历来依赖于局限于封闭集诊断标签的判别式分类器、信号重建或显著性热图。这些静态分类器虽能较好地对预定义的心律失常进行分类，却无法生成叙述性临床报告、纳入患者病史，也无法支持交互式临床问答（Q&A）。我们提出 LifeLine.ai，一个端到端的多模态 Vision-ECG-Language 框架，用于自动化心脏诊断和临床报告生成。在波形峰值追踪和坐标映射的早期尝试因复杂的形态学变异而失败之后，我们利用了大规模 PhysioNet 数据库（MIMIC-IV 和 PTB-XL）。由于硬件限制无法在超过 800,000 条原始记录上进行训练，我们整理了一个均衡子集以评估性能，将一维信号转换为 3x4 的十二导联网格，并在底部附有连续的 II 导联节律条。我们的流程整合了 YOLOv11s 定位、经 LoRA 适配的 Google SigLIP 编码器、可训练的多层感知机（Multi-Layer Perceptron）投影器以及 4 位量化的 MedGemma-4B 模型，并辅以基于收集的用户反馈构建的独立 Kahneman-Tversky 优化（KTO）流程和多 LLM 共识引擎。在这一紧凑子集上，SigLIP 优于 Swin Transformer 编码（验证损失约 0.21 对约 0.25），在涵盖 Vercel、移动应用、Amazon EC2、Firebase、Hugging Face、Modal GPU 和 lifelinecg-sdk 的云端部署中，取得了 71.0% 的开放词汇精确率和 75.0% 的上下文 F1 分数。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Asad939asad/ LifeLine.ai- 获取。

abstract: [Journal of hepatocellular carcinoma] To develop and evaluate a Combined model integrating multiphase contrast-enhanced MRI intratumoral habitat radiomics, deep learning, and clinical information for preoperative, noninvasive prediction of vessels encapsulating tumor clusters (VETC) status in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). A total of 140 patients from two centers were pooled and randomly divided at the patient level into a training cohort (n=98) and an internal hold-out test cohort (n=42); no independent center-level external validation was performed. MRI sequence-specific k-means clustering was performed separately on arterial-phase, portal venous-phase, and delayed-phase images to generate three intratumoral habitats per phase. From each habitat, 107 radiomics features were extracted; the ITHScore model was developed after rank-sum testing, correlation filtering, and elastic-net selection. The DeepScore model was based on a ResNet-50 pretrained on RadImageNet. Peripheral washout, serum albumin, absolute lymphocyte count, ITHScore, and DeepScore were integrated into the Combined model. Model performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic curves, calibration curves, calibration intercepts and slopes, Brier scores, decision curve analysis, DeLong tests, and Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) analysis. The Combined model achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.885 (95% confidence interval (CI), 0.819-0.950), a sensitivity of 0.857, and a specificity of 0.810 in the training cohort, and an AUC of 0.840 (95% CI, 0.711-0.969), a sensitivity of 0.824, and a specificity of 0.760 in the test cohort. In the test cohort, the AUCs of the Clinical, DeepScore, and ITHScore models were 0.631, 0.782, and 0.795, respectively. The Brier scores of the Combined model were 0.149 and 0.175 in the training and test cohorts, respectively. SHAP analysis identified ITHScore and DeepScore as the two largest contributors to the Combined model. The Combined model integrating multiphase contrast-enhanced MRI intratumoral habitat radiomics, a deep learning score, and clinical variables showed an AUC of 0.840 for identifying VETC-positive HCC in the internal hold-out test cohort and provided incremental value over the Clinical model alone. Independent external validation remains necessary.

The paradigm changes from healthcare 4.0 to healthcare 5.0 is being driven by AI.ObjectiveThis work begins with the roadmap of various enabling technologies that important in medical fields.MethodsThe work established by a methodical literature review and bibliometric approach to investigate different promising technologies like artificial intelligence, deep learning, natural language processing, and traditional machine learning, and assesses their applications in healthcare.ResultsImportant discoveries show that how artificial intelligent greatly increases diagnostic precision and supports personalized medicine; yet, incorporating these technologies into clinical processes, presents difficulties, including concerns about data quality, privacy, and ethics.ConclusionSeveral examples of healthcare use cases to improved interpretability and sophisticated AI models are needed in the future in healthcare 5.0, Lastly, combined with regulatory frameworks to guarantee deployment in healthcare settings both safe and efficient in future research.
zh_abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine]【背景】在本研究工作中，我们开展了一项广泛的综述，全面探讨人工智能（AI），特别是机器学习和深度学习技术，如何改变医疗保健，以改进疾病的检测、诊断和治疗。AI 正在推动医疗保健从 4.0 向 5.0 的范式转变。【目的】本工作首先给出对医学领域至关重要的各类使能技术的路线图。【方法】本工作通过系统性文献综述和文献计量学方法，考察人工智能、深度学习、自然语言处理和传统机器学习等多种有前景的技术，并评估它们在医疗保健中的应用。【结果】重要发现表明，人工智能可大幅提高诊断精度并支持个性化医疗；然而，将这些技术纳入临床流程存在困难，包括数据质量、隐私和伦理方面的顾虑。【结论】未来在医疗保健 5.0 中，需要若干医疗保健用例以提高可解释性，并需要更为复杂的 AI 模型；最后，在未来研究中还需结合监管框架，以保证这些技术在医疗环境中的部署既安全又有效。

abstract: [The Libyan journal of medicine] Thoracic infections are deemed extraordinary cases that need to be detected early to improve their corresponding management. Among these, tuberculosis (TB) and coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) are the most dangerous and highly transmissible infections. They overlapped during the COVID-19 outbreak. One of the major diagnostic tools is the chest X-ray (CXR), which is attainable in most of the healthcare centers worldwide. Artificial intelligence (AI) has facilitated and improved the prediction of these and other diseases in recent years. Hence, the present study aimed to deploy a deep learning approach to predict TB and COVID-19 in comparison with healthy controls via CXR images. Google's Inception v3 model was used as the embedder, reputable for its speed and accuracy in image classification. Orange data mining software was utilized for the implementation of a deep neural network for diagnostic purposes of 268 each for controls, TB, and COVID-19 cases, while extracting 100 cases from each class for further external validation. A total of 100 neurons for 200 iterations and adaptive momentum (Adam) were used as the solver. The area under the curve (AUC) scored 1, while the accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-statistic were 98%. Upon internal validation for 300 cases, the constructed model displayed a slight drop in performance, with the AUC and other metrics decreasing to 0.997 and 0.967, respectively. However, the AUC and accuracy dropped to 0.88 and 66% after external validation. These findings highlight its potential as a diagnostic support tool while emphasizing the need for broader external validation and improved generalizability before clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [利比亚医学杂志] 胸部感染被视为需要早期发现以改进相应处理的特殊病例。其中，结核病（TB）和2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）是最危险且传播性最强的感染，二者在COVID-19疫情期间发生重叠。主要诊断工具之一是胸部X线（CXR），全球大多数医疗中心均可获得。近年来，人工智能（AI）促进并改进了对这些疾病及其他疾病的预测。因此，本研究旨在通过CXR图像，采用深度学习方法预测TB和COVID-19，并与健康对照进行比较。使用以图像分类速度和准确性著称的 Google Inception v3 模型作为嵌入器。使用 Orange 数据挖掘软件构建深度神经网络用于诊断，对照、TB 和 COVID-19 病例各268例，同时从每一类中抽取100例用于进一步的外部验证。求解器采用100个神经元、200次迭代和自适应动量（Adam）。曲线下面积（AUC）为1，而准确率、精确率、召回率和F1统计量均为98%。对300例进行内部验证时，所构建模型的性能略有下降，AUC及其他指标分别降至0.997和0.967。然而，外部验证后AUC和准确率降至0.88和66%。这些发现凸显了其作为诊断辅助工具的潜力，同时强调在临床应用之前需要更广泛的外部验证并提高泛化能力。

abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] Background Machine learning has been increasingly applied to predicting postoperative outcomes in genitourinary cancers. However, a comprehensive understanding of the research landscape, major hotspots, and emerging trends in this field remains limited.ObjectiveTo analyse the research status, hotspots and future trends of machine learning in predicting postoperative outcomes of genitourinary cancers.MethodsEnglish-language studies published up to 30 May 2026 were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection. Annual publication trends were analysed using Excel, and VOSviewer and CiteSpace were used to visualise authors, countries, institutions, co-cited references and keywords.ResultsA total of 296 publications were included. Annual publication output showed an overall upward trend from 2021 to 2025, with a marked increase in 2025. China and the United States were the leading contributors, followed by England and Italy. The University of Texas System, Sun Yat-sen University, and the University of California System were among the most productive institutions. Co-citation analysis identified an interdisciplinary knowledge base encompassing cancer epidemiology, clinical guidelines, prognostic risk assessment, radiomics, and artificial intelligence. Keyword analyses highlighted machine learning, prostate cancer, deep learning, prognosis, and survival prediction as prominent research themes, with increasing attention to model evaluation, survival outcomes, and treatment planning.ConclusionThe bibliometric findings suggest increasing research attention to multimodal data integration, external validation, and clinical translation. However, further prospective studies are needed to establish whether these developments translate into meaningful improvements in clinical decision-making and patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: 【背景】机器学习越来越多地应用于预测泌尿生殖系统癌症的术后结局。然而，对该领域的研究格局、主要热点和新兴趋势的全面了解仍然有限。【目的】分析机器学习预测泌尿生殖系统癌症术后结局的研究现状、热点和未来趋势。【方法】从 Web of Science 核心合集检索截至2026年5月30日发表的英文研究。使用 Excel 分析年度发文趋势，并使用 VOSviewer 和 CiteSpace 对作者、国家、机构、共被引文献和关键词进行可视化。【结果】共纳入296篇文献。2021年至2025年年度发文量总体呈上升趋势，2025年显著增加。中国和美国是主要贡献国，其次是英国和意大利。得克萨斯大学系统、中山大学和加利福尼亚大学系统是产出最多的机构之一。共被引分析确定了一个跨学科知识基础，涵盖癌症流行病学、临床指南、预后风险评估、影像组学和人工智能。关键词分析突出了机器学习、前列腺癌、深度学习、预后和生存预测等主要研究主题，同时对模型评估、生存结局和治疗规划的关注日益增加。【结论】文献计量学结果提示，对多模态数据整合、外部验证和临床转化的研究关注日益增加。然而，仍需要进一步的前瞻性研究，以确定这些进展是否能转化为临床决策和患者结局的实质性改善。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven precision diagnosis and management of cutaneous lupus erythematosus: from lesion recognition and multi-omics profiling to clinical decision support.
zh_title: AI驱动的皮肤型红斑狼疮精准诊断与管理叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述按临床任务、数据模态与验证成熟度评估CLE相关AI证据，涵盖病灶识别、多组学与临床决策支持。

NLP研究从体检记录估算CLASI评分，属概念验证
