abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE) poses challenges in differential diagnosis, subtype classification, and longitudinal management because of its heterogeneous phenotypes and variable association with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). This narrative review evaluates artificial intelligence (AI) evidence by clinical task, data modality, disease relevance, and validation maturity. Direct CLE studies provide early evidence for image-based lesion and subtype classification, including a multicentre multimodal system that improved dermatologists' diagnostic accuracy. A separate proof-of-concept study used natural language processing (NLP) to estimate Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus Disease Area and Severity Index (CLASI) activity and damage scores from physical-examination notes. This text-based result should not be interpreted as automated severity scoring from clinical photographs: image-based lesion segmentation and CLASI estimation remain proposed applications. CLE transcriptomic, single-cell, and spatial studies reveal subtype-related B-cell signatures, interferon-associated keratinocyte states, specialized fibroblasts, and altered cell-cell communication; these findings are biological foundations for future models rather than validated patient-level prediction systems. Across applications, the level of CLE relevance is distinct from the maturity of validation. Current limitations include small or incompletely characterized disease-specific subsets, inconsistent image acquisition, uncertain independence of test cohorts, and limited prospective assessment of clinical utility. Progress requires transparent reporting of CLE-specific denominators, patient-level data separation, independent external validation, calibration, pigmentation-aware subgroup assessment, and clinician-supervised prospective evaluation. AI should therefore be regarded as an investigational decision-support approach for CLE, with clinical benefit established through disease-specific testing.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 皮肤型红斑狼疮（CLE）由于其表型异质性以及与系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的关联多变，在鉴别诊断、亚型分类和长期管理方面存在挑战。本叙述性综述按临床任务、数据模态、疾病相关性和验证成熟度评估人工智能（AI）证据。直接针对CLE的研究为基于图像的皮损和亚型分类提供了早期证据，其中包括一个多中心多模态系统，该系统提高了皮肤科医生的诊断准确性。另一项概念验证研究利用自然语言处理（NLP），从体格检查记录中估计皮肤型红斑狼疮疾病面积和严重程度指数（CLASI）的活动度和损伤评分。这一基于文本的结果不应被解读为根据临床照片进行的自动严重程度评分：基于图像的皮损分割和CLASI估计仍属于拟议的应用。CLE的转录组、单细胞和空间研究揭示了与亚型相关的B细胞特征、干扰素相关的角质形成细胞状态、特化的成纤维细胞以及改变的细胞间通讯；这些发现是未来模型的生物学基础，而非经过验证的患者层面预测系统。在各类应用中，CLE相关程度有别于验证成熟度。目前的局限包括疾病特异性子集规模小或特征描述不完整、图像采集不一致、测试队列独立性不确定，以及对临床效用的前瞻性评估有限。要取得进展，需要透明报告CLE特异性分母、患者层面的数据分离、独立外部验证、校准、考虑色素沉着的亚组评估，以及在临床医生监督下的前瞻性评价。因此，AI应被视为CLE的一种研究性决策支持方法，其临床获益需通过疾病特异性检验来确立。

title: Comparative evaluation of large language model chatbots for pheochromocytoma education: accuracy, information quality, transparency, and readability.
zh_title: 嗜铬细胞瘤科普：四种大模型聊天机器人对比评估
summary: 比较四种大模型回答200道嗜铬细胞瘤选择题及患者问题的准确性、信息质量、透明度与可读性。
key_points: 准确率：ChatGPT 93.00%，Grok 81.67%
总体准确率差异显著（p=0.0012）
采用DISCERN、EQIP、GQS、JAMA及可读性指标
reason: 单病种聊天机器人对比，无临床结局，增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Large language model (LLM)-based chatbots are increasingly used for medical information, but their suitability for pheochromocytoma education remains uncertain. We compared four contemporary LLMs for knowledge accuracy, information quality, transparency, and readability. ChatGPT (ChatGPT-5.6 Sol), DeepSeek (DeepSeek-V4 Flash), Gemini (Gemini-3.6 Flash), and Grok (Grok-4.5 Fast) answered 200 pheochromocytoma-related multiple-choice questions across three independent trials. Google Trends and clinician input were used to develop 15 patient-centered questions. Responses were evaluated using DISCERN, EQIP, GQS, JAMA benchmark criteria, and six readability indices. Overall knowledge accuracy differed among the four models (p = 0.0012), with mean accuracy rates of 93.00% for ChatGPT, 91.17% for DeepSeek, 90.50% for Gemini, and 81.67% for Grok. However, after adjustment for multiple comparisons, statistically significant pairwise differences were limited to ChatGPT versus Grok for overall accuracy (adjusted p = 0.0129) and clinical-presentation questions (adjusted p = 0.0088). No significant differences were identified among ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini. Exploratory assessments of 15 patient-oriented questions suggested differences in information quality, transparency, and readability across models. ChatGPT showed comparatively favorable information quality scores, whereas DeepSeek exhibited a more favorable descriptive readability profile. Nevertheless, transparency was limited across all models, and none achieved the recommended sixth-grade readability standard. The evaluated LLM-based chatbots demonstrated generally favorable performance on structured pheochromocytoma-related knowledge questions, although statistically significant pairwise differences in accuracy were limited. Findings from the exploratory patient-oriented assessments suggested potential differences in information quality and readability but require confirmation in larger studies. Persistent limitations in transparency and readability highlight the importance of clinician oversight, source verification, and linguistic simplification before these tools are used for patient education.
zh_abstract: [公共卫生前沿] 基于大语言模型（LLM）的聊天机器人越来越多地用于获取医学信息，但其是否适用于嗜铬细胞瘤教育仍不确定。我们比较了四种当代LLM在知识准确性、信息质量、透明度和可读性方面的表现。ChatGPT（ChatGPT-5.6 Sol）、DeepSeek（DeepSeek-V4 Flash）、Gemini（Gemini-3.6 Flash）和Grok（Grok-4.5 Fast）在三次独立试验中回答了200道与嗜铬细胞瘤相关的选择题。利用Google Trends和临床医生意见形成了15个以患者为中心的问题。使用DISCERN、EQIP、GQS、JAMA基准标准及六项可读性指标对回答进行评估。四种模型的总体知识准确率存在差异（p = 0.0012），平均准确率分别为ChatGPT 93.00%、DeepSeek 91.17%、Gemini 90.50%、Grok 81.67%。然而，在多重比较校正后，具有统计学意义的两两差异仅限于ChatGPT与Grok之间的总体准确率（校正后p = 0.0129）和临床表现类问题（校正后p = 0.0088）。ChatGPT、DeepSeek与Gemini之间未发现显著差异。对15个面向患者问题的探索性评估提示，各模型在信息质量、透明度和可读性方面存在差异。ChatGPT的信息质量评分相对较优，而DeepSeek在描述性可读性方面表现较优。然而，所有模型的透明度均有限，且均未达到推荐的六年级可读性标准。所评估的基于LLM的聊天机器人在结构化的嗜铬细胞瘤知识问题上总体表现良好，尽管准确率方面具有统计学意义的两两差异有限。面向患者的探索性评估结果提示信息质量和可读性可能存在差异，但需在更大规模研究中加以证实。透明度和可读性方面持续存在的局限性凸显了在将这些工具用于患者教育之前，进行临床医生监督、来源核查和语言简化的重要性。

title: GeneArbiter improves plant genome annotations while preserving established gene models
zh_title: GeneArbiter：在保留既有基因模型的同时改进植物基因组注释
summary: GeneArbiter以现有注释为骨架，整合替代模型与证据，用受限语言模型仲裁更新注释，在水稻MH63中基因水平精确命中率由70.77%升至77.77%。
key_points: 水稻MH63净增2811个精确匹配
保留TAIR12成熟注释97.54%的蛋白编码基因
结合剪接位点与同源蛋白证据
reason: 植物基因组注释，与医疗关联较弱，预印本
abstract: As plant genome resources expand, updating established annotations requires incorporating improved gene models without disrupting correct structures or stable identifiers. We developed GeneArbiter, an evidence guided framework that treats annotation updating as a correction preservation problem. GeneArbiter uses the current annotation as a backbone, integrates alternative models with RNA splice junction and homologous protein evidence, and applies constrained language model arbitration followed by deterministic release and identifier reconciliation. In rice MH63, GeneArbiter recovered 4,701 reference loci missed by the current annotation while losing 1,890 current exact loci, yielding a net gain of 2,811 exact matches and increasing the gene level exact hit rate from 70.77% to 77.77%. It retained 97.54% of protein coding genes in the mature TAIR12 annotation and improved protein set quality metrics across 16 plant genomes. Independent transcript and protein evidence further supported GeneArbiter selected structural revisions at reference discordant loci. These results establish GeneArbiter as a conservative and traceable framework for maintaining plant genome annotations as new predictions and biological evidence accumulate.
zh_abstract: 随着植物基因组资源不断扩充，更新既有注释需要纳入改进的基因模型，同时不破坏正确的结构或稳定的标识符。我们开发了GeneArbiter，这是一个证据引导的框架，将注释更新视为一个“纠错与保留”问题。GeneArbiter以当前注释为骨架，整合替代模型以及RNA剪接位点和同源蛋白证据，应用受约束的语言模型仲裁，随后进行确定性的版本发布和标识符整合。在水稻MH63中，GeneArbiter找回了当前注释遗漏的4,701个参考基因座，同时丢失了1,890个当前注释中完全匹配的基因座，净增2,811个完全匹配，使基因水平的完全命中率从70.77%提高到77.77%。它保留了成熟的TAIR12注释中97.54%的蛋白编码基因，并在16个植物基因组中改善了蛋白集质量指标。独立的转录本和蛋白证据进一步支持了GeneArbiter在与参考不一致的基因座上所选择的结构修订。这些结果表明，GeneArbiter是一个保守且可追溯的框架，可在新的预测和生物学证据不断积累的情况下维护植物基因组注释。

title: RecurSieve: A Python Package to Detect Subtle Gene Expression Differences Across Single-Cell RNA-seq Comparisons Using Iterative Machine Learning
zh_title: RecurSieve：用迭代机器学习检测单细胞差异表达的Python包
summary: RecurSieve采用迭代集成学习，结合分类与无监督聚类，识别单细胞RNA-seq中传统均值检验可能遗漏的细微分布差异基因集。
key_points: 可检测联合表达与分布形状变化
训练中动态重分配标签以应对细胞异质性
在模拟数据基准实验中评估
reason: 新工具预印本，证据主要来自模拟基准
abstract: Most existing methods for performing differential expression testing using single-cell RNA-seq data evaluate genes independently and primarily detect shifts in mean RNA levels. These methods may thus miss RNAs that distinguish experimental groups jointly or through changes in the shape of genes' expression distributions. To address this limitation, we developed RecurSieve, an iterative ensemble learning method that combines shared expression classification with unsupervised clustering to recursively identify gene sets with group-based expression differences. Because experimental labels apply to heterogeneous populations of single cells within each comparative group, RecurSieve allows dynamic label reassignment during iterative training to detect subtle, non-linear expression patterns. In benchmarking experiments using simulated data with staged distributional expression differences, RecurSieve recovered more genes (2.3-3.9 of 10 staged genes) across groups as compared to standard methods (Wilcoxon, t-test, and logistic regression; 0.0-0.7 staged genes). When applied to a single nuclei RNA-seq analysis containing low and high-pathology stages of Alzheimer's disease (46 human donor brains), RecurSieve extended results from standard approaches by identifying genes including WWOX, DPP10, KCNIP4, HS6ST3, and CNTN5 which tend to exhibit stage-specific distributional expression differences accompanied by only minor changes in average expression. A subset of the genes exclusively detected in RecurSieve analysis had been previously associated with Alzheimer's disease, underscoring the potential importance resulting from the unique sensitivity of our method. These simulated and empirical single-cell RNA-seq results demonstrate how the RecurSieve framework complements standard methods for identifying genes with unique group-specific expression differences independent of changes in average expression.
zh_abstract: 现有的大多数利用单细胞 RNA-seq 数据进行差异表达检验的方法对基因独立评估，且主要检测 RNA 水平均值的变化。因此，这些方法可能会遗漏那些联合区分实验组、或通过基因表达分布形状变化来区分实验组的 RNA。为解决这一局限，我们开发了 RecurSieve，这是一种迭代式集成学习方法，将共享表达分类与无监督聚类相结合，以递归方式识别存在组间表达差异的基因集。由于实验标签适用于每个比较组内异质的单细胞群体，RecurSieve 允许在迭代训练过程中动态重新分配标签，以检测细微的非线性表达模式。在使用具有分阶段分布性表达差异的模拟数据的基准实验中，与标准方法（Wilcoxon 检验、t 检验和逻辑回归；0.0–0.7 个设定基因）相比，RecurSieve 在各组间找回了更多基因（10 个设定基因中的 2.3–3.9 个）。当应用于包含阿尔茨海默病低病理和高病理阶段的单细胞核 RNA-seq 分析（46 个人类供体大脑）时，RecurSieve 扩展了标准方法的结果，识别出包括 WWOX、DPP10、KCNIP4、HS6ST3 和 CNTN5 在内的基因，这些基因往往表现出阶段特异性的分布性表达差异，而平均表达仅有轻微变化。仅在 RecurSieve 分析中检出的基因中，有一部分此前已被报道与阿尔茨海默病相关，凸显了本方法独特灵敏度所带来的潜在重要性。这些模拟及实际单细胞 RNA-seq 结果表明，RecurSieve 框架可作为标准方法的补充，用于识别具有组特异性表达差异、且与平均表达变化无关的基因。

title: VS-Suite: Automated Consensus Virtual Screening Platform for Improved Screening of Small Molecules
zh_title: VS-Suite：小分子共识虚拟筛选自动化平台
summary: 预印本介绍整合 Boltz-2 共折叠、AutoDock Vina 与 GNINA 的共识虚拟筛选平台 VS-Suite，用于小分子筛选。
key_points: 基于 Boltz-2 预测复合物结构与亲和力

摘要未见完整基准结果
reason: 药物发现工具型预印本，摘要缺乏验证细节，属增量档
abstract: Growing the recent advances in artificial intelligence and machine leaning (AI&ML) approaches accelerated small molecules screening against targeted proteins with limited computational resources and time. Finding accurate binding pose and affinity prediction is challenges task and traditional docking tools and lacks the reproducibility. Development of the Co-folding model is paradigm shift in drug discovery and development, allowing to predict protein ligand complexes without experimental crystal structures. Notably Boltz-2 predicts the complex structure along with binding affinity directly using protein FASTA sequence and ligand SMILES. Our previous studies confirmed that Boltz-2 is classify binder non-binders effectively. Autodock Vina and GNINA are widely used docking with knowledge and CNN based scoring functions allows to screen potential small molecules. We developed in-house VS-suite (Virtual Screening Suite) multi-environment conda orchestration designed to automate the docking workflow only using FASTA and SMILES string as inputs via streamlit-based browser GUI which integrates the boltz-2 for the complex structure prediction followed docking using AutoDock Vina for Gnina. Validation on 58 antiviral nucleoside analogues screened against SARS-CoV-2 main protease (Mpro). VS-Suite is available at https://github.com/Vsubuchem-lab/Virtual-screening-suite-VS-Suite. This consensus approaches helpful in rapid screening of small molecules against selected targets. The findings and VS-suite support its utility as a rapid and reliable tool for hit identification and rational drug development.
zh_abstract: 人工智能和机器学习（AI&ML）方法的最新进展，使得在有限计算资源和时间下针对靶蛋白进行小分子筛选得以加速。准确的结合构象和亲和力预测是一项具有挑战性的任务，而传统对接工具缺乏可重复性。共折叠（Co-folding）模型的发展是药物发现与开发中的范式转变，使得无需实验晶体结构即可预测蛋白–配体复合物。值得注意的是，Boltz-2可直接利用蛋白质FASTA序列和配体SMILES预测复合物结构及结合亲和力。我们既往的研究证实Boltz-2能有效区分结合物与非结合物。AutoDock Vina和GNINA是广泛使用的对接工具，分别采用基于知识的和基于CNN的打分函数，可用于筛选潜在小分子。我们开发了自有的VS-suite（虚拟筛选套件），这是一个多环境conda编排系统，旨在仅以FASTA和SMILES字符串为输入，通过基于streamlit的浏览器图形界面自动化对接流程，该流程整合Boltz-2进行复合物结构预测，随后使用AutoDock Vina和Gnina进行对接。该套件在针对SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶（Mpro）筛选的58种抗病毒核苷类似物上进行了验证。VS-Suite可在 https://github.com/Vsubuchem-lab/Virtual-screening-suite-VS-Suite 获取。这种共识方法有助于针对选定靶点快速筛选小分子。研究结果及VS-suite支持其作为命中化合物识别和合理药物开发的快速可靠工具的实用性。

title: CellTouch: Learning to separate touching nuclei in anisotropic 3D cell cultures
zh_title: CellTouch：各向异性3D细胞培养中粘连细胞核分离
summary: 提出预测流场和接触通道的深度学习方法，用于各向异性3D类器官/球体细胞核实例分割，称优于现有方法。
key_points: 接触通道为关键设计，消融验证
在自有及公开数据集上优于现有方法
针对Z轴采样稀疏的3D培养
reason: 方法有对比但为预印本，属基础研究工具，增量档
abstract: 3D-oids, such as spheroids and organoids, are essential models in drug discovery and precision medicine, and quantitative analysis requires every nucleus to be segmented separately. Accurate 3D instance segmentation remains challenging, because nuclei are densely packed and touching, and volumes are sampled more coarsely along the Z-axis than laterally. Most existing methods were developed for near-isotropic data and tend to merge neighbouring nuclei. To address this challenge, we propose CellTouch, a deep learning method for anisotropic 3D nuclei instance segmentation that predicts flow fields and a contact channel, which separates touching nuclei directly from the network output. Ablations showed that the contact channel is the key design element, and CellTouch outperformed state-of-the-art methods on in-house data and widely used public datasets. Most importantly, dense Z-sampling is not required: CellTouch segmented nuclei as accurately at a 2 um Z-step as at 0.5 um, reducing acquisition time and data volume four-fold.
zh_abstract: 3D-oids（如球状体和类器官）是药物发现和精准医学中的重要模型，其定量分析要求对每个细胞核分别进行分割。准确的三维实例分割仍具有挑战性，因为细胞核密集排列且相互接触，并且体数据沿 Z 轴的采样比横向更稀疏。大多数现有方法针对近各向同性数据开发，往往会将相邻的细胞核合并。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 CellTouch，一种用于各向异性三维细胞核实例分割的深度学习方法，它预测流场和一个接触通道，可直接从网络输出中分离相互接触的细胞核。消融实验表明，接触通道是关键的设计要素；在自有数据和广泛使用的公开数据集上，CellTouch 的表现均优于最先进的方法。最重要的是，无需密集的 Z 轴采样：CellTouch 在 2 μm Z 步长下分割细胞核的准确度与 0.5 μm 时相当，从而将采集时间和数据量减少至四分之一。

title: L++: A Language for Programming Life
zh_title: L++：用于“编程生命”的建模语言
summary: 预印本提出L++语言，以分子、反应、细胞、器官、种群等生物学名词统一描述、模拟和设计生命系统，人类与AI均可编写。
key_points: 同一语法覆盖从反应到种群的嵌套尺度
带单位、空间与时间，可选多种速率律
可在机制未知时按输入、输出和速率描述过程
reason: 新颖建模语言但摘要无验证信息，属增量档
abstract: Living systems run on a code written in DNA or RNA, but expressing that code as a model that scientists can write, run and read remains difficult. We present L++, a holistic programming language in which life can be described, simulated and, beyond that, designed; its nouns are biological, and people and AI systems can both write it. Molecules, reactions, compartments, cells, organs and populations are written directly and nest by containment, so one grammar spans a reaction and the population around it. Quantities carry units, objects take places in space, and values can be set in time. Named kinetic parameters select one family of rate laws, from mass action to cooperative enzyme kinetics, and a few operators write complexes, states and gene products in one line. Modules compose by import, and a process can be written by its inputs, outputs and rate before its mechanism is known; the aim is that one description can model an organism or design one. lppc compiles a program and lpps runs it, and a run repeats exactly with the same build, options and seed. Ten programs written with an AI assistant, from an enzyme in a tube to a lake ecosystem and a drug therapy from molecule to patient, show the language across levels of biological organization, and a genome-scale virtual Escherichia coli, reported separately, shows it holds a whole organism. Our ultimate goal is the Human Code: the human, from molecules to the whole body, written in L++ as a mechanistic model that runs.
zh_abstract: 生命系统依靠以 DNA 或 RNA 书写的代码运行，但要把这套代码表达成科学家可以编写、运行和阅读的模型仍然很困难。我们提出了 L++，这是一种整体性的编程语言，生命可以用它来描述、模拟，并且进一步被设计；它的名词都是生物学的，人和 AI 系统都可以编写。分子、反应、区室、细胞、器官和种群可以直接书写，并按包含关系嵌套，因此同一套语法既能描述一个反应，也能描述其周围的种群。量带有单位，对象占据空间中的位置，数值可以随时间设定。具名的动力学参数用于选择某一类速率定律，范围从质量作用到协同酶动力学；少数几个运算符可以在一行中写出复合物、状态和基因产物。模块通过导入进行组合；在机制尚未明确之前，即可通过输入、输出和速率来书写一个过程；其目标是让同一种描述既能为一个生物体建模，也能用来设计一个生物体。lppc 编译程序，lpps 运行程序，使用相同的构建、选项和随机种子时，运行结果可以完全重复。借助 AI 助手编写的十个程序，从试管中的一种酶，到湖泊生态系统，再到从分子到患者的药物治疗，展示了该语言在各个生物组织层次上的应用；另有单独报道的基因组规模虚拟大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）表明，该语言能够容纳整个生物体。我们的最终目标是“人类代码”（Human Code）：用 L++ 写出从分子到全身的人体，成为可运行的机制模型。

title: Distance-stratified benchmarking of variant-effect predictors on β-lactamase deep mutational scanning data
zh_title: β-内酰胺酶深度突变扫描中变异效应预测器的距离分层基准
summary: 预印本以TEM-1与VIM-2的深度突变扫描数据，评估ESM2、ThermoMPNN及结构描述符随距催化残基距离变化的预测表现。
key_points: ESM2在TEM-1上随距离增大相关性下降
稳定性评分的相关性随距离升高
加入稳定性使远距位点交叉验证ρ提高约0.10
reason: 蛋白语言模型基准，仅两种酶，增量档
abstract: Mutations far from the active site of antibiotic-resistance enzymes can change resistance, but it is unclear what information predicts their effects. We asked how the performance of a protein language model (ESM2), a structure-based stability predictor (ThermoMPNN) and simple structural descriptors changes with distance from the catalytic residues, using deep mutational scanning data for the {beta}-lactamases TEM-1 (four assays) and VIM-2 (one assay). We measured Spearman correlation and AUROC within distance bins, with bootstrap intervals over positions. In TEM-1, ESM2 accuracy fell with distance (Stiffler assay: {rho} = 0.72 below 8 [A] and 0.42 beyond 20 [A]), while the stability score rose ({rho} = 0.41 to 0.70). Adding stability to a model of ESM2, solvent accessibility and neighbour count improved cross-validated {rho} by 0.02 below 8 [A] and 0.10 beyond 20 [A], and the combined model did not decline with distance. The pattern held across binning schemes, in a continuous-distance model, and when any one of five contiguous distal stretches was removed. Two TEM-1 assays are nearly duplicates, and the Deng assay was too noisy to be informative. VIM-2 has only seven positions beyond 20 [A] and showed no detectable trend within 20 [A], so it neither supports nor contradicts the TEM-1 pattern. Nine distal TEM-1 positions remained more sensitive than the models predicted. In TEM-1, predicted stability was more informative than the language model far from the catalytic site, and the language model was stronger near it. Distance-stratified reporting could add to variant-effect benchmarks. The study is exploratory and uses one structure and one phenotype per assay.
zh_abstract: 远离抗生素耐药酶活性位点的突变可改变耐药性，但目前尚不清楚何种信息可预测其效应。我们利用β-内酰胺酶TEM-1（四项实验）和VIM-2（一项实验）的深度突变扫描数据，探讨蛋白质语言模型（ESM2）、基于结构的稳定性预测器（ThermoMPNN）以及简单结构描述符的性能如何随与催化残基距离的变化而变化。我们在各距离区间内计算了Spearman相关系数和AUROC，并对位点进行自助法（bootstrap）区间估计。在TEM-1中，ESM2的准确性随距离增加而下降（Stiffler实验：距离小于8 Å时ρ = 0.72，大于20 Å时为0.42），而稳定性评分则上升（ρ = 0.41至0.70）。在由ESM2、溶剂可及性和邻近残基数构成的模型中加入稳定性后，交叉验证的ρ在小于8 Å时提高了0.02，在大于20 Å时提高了0.10，且组合模型的表现不随距离而下降。该模式在不同的分区方案、连续距离模型中，以及去除五个连续远端片段中的任意一个时均成立。TEM-1的两项实验几乎是重复的，而Deng实验噪声过大，缺乏信息价值。VIM-2在20 Å以外只有七个位点，且在20 Å以内未检测到明显趋势，因此既不支持也不反驳TEM-1的模式。九个TEM-1远端位点仍比模型预测的更敏感。在TEM-1中，远离催化位点处，预测的稳定性比语言模型提供更多信息，而在靠近催化位点处语言模型更强。按距离分层报告可为变异效应基准评估增添内容。本研究为探索性研究，每项实验仅使用一个结构和一种表型。

title: A Benchmark for Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Enzyme Kinetic Parameters of Metabolic Networks
zh_title: 代谢网络高维酶动力学参数生成建模基准
summary: 预印本提出用于生成酶动力学参数集的基准，含大肠杆菌可行动力学模型数据集，并按动态稳定性与表型一致性评估三类生成架构。
key_points: 提供大肠杆菌动力学可行模型数据集
评估动态稳定性与实验表型一致性
在匹配容量下比较三种标准生成架构
reason: 代谢建模基准，领域较窄，预印本
abstract: Large-scale kinetic models predict how metabolism responds to genetic and environmental perturbations, but building them at scale is limited by the scarcity of experimentally determined enzyme kinetic parameters. Generative machine learning has been proposed to address this bottleneck, yet prior work has each introduced a single, bespoke architecture, leaving open which generative paradigm suits this problem and why. We introduce a benchmark suite for generative modeling of high-dimensional enzyme kinetic parameter sets: labeled datasets of kinetically feasible Escherichia coli models paired with a mechanistically grounded evaluation harness that scores generated ensembles on dynamical stability and agreement with experimentally observed phenotypes, rather than statistical realism alone. Using it, we compare three standard architectures at matched capacity, a conditional variational autoencoder, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty, and a RealNVP normalizing flow, each under two conditioning schemes (a discrete high/low label and a continuous, graded key-performance-indicator target), across a difficulty ladder from one mutant phenotype to a stringent class of nine reproduced jointly. Two findings stand out. The architectures trace a consistent concentration-exploration trade-off, the VAE concentrating, the flow exploring and extrapolating, the GAN in between, but this ordering is overturned at high stringency by the conditioning scheme: at the joint class, continuous targets reach 33 to 117-fold enrichment over random sampling for every architecture, whereas discrete labels stay at 1.3 to 15-fold. Beyond the comparison, the suite is an accessible, mechanistically validated reference task for groups outside the kinetic-modeling community to benchmark their own generative algorithms.
zh_abstract: 大规模动力学模型可预测代谢对遗传和环境扰动的反应，但其大规模构建受限于经实验测定的酶动力学参数稀缺。生成式机器学习已被提出用于解决这一瓶颈，然而既往工作各自仅引入单一的定制架构，何种生成范式适合该问题及其原因仍不明确。我们提出了一套用于高维酶动力学参数集生成建模的基准：包含动力学上可行的大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）模型的带标签数据集，并配有基于机制的评估框架，该框架根据动力学稳定性以及与实验观察到的表型的一致性来为生成的集合打分，而不仅仅依据统计真实性。利用该基准，我们在匹配容量下比较了三种标准架构——条件变分自编码器（VAE）、带梯度惩罚的 Wasserstein GAN 以及 RealNVP 归一化流，每种架构均采用两种条件化方案（离散的高/低标签和连续的、分级的关键性能指标目标），并跨越从单一突变体表型到联合再现九种表型的严格类别的难度阶梯。有两项发现尤为突出。这些架构呈现出一致的集中—探索权衡：VAE 倾向集中，流模型倾向探索与外推，GAN 介于两者之间；但在高严格度下，这一顺序被条件化方案所颠覆：在联合类别中，连续目标使每种架构相对随机采样均达到 33 至 117 倍的富集，而离散标签仅为 1.3 至 15 倍。除比较之外，该基准套件还是一个易于使用、经机制验证的参考任务，可供动力学建模领域之外的团队用来评测其自身的生成算法。

title: rnaModScan: context-aware deep learning-based filtering of nanopore m6A and inosine calls
zh_title: rnaModScan：基于深度学习的纳米孔m6A与肌苷位点过滤
summary: 预印本提出rnaModScan，整合Dorado分数与序列、比对特征，过滤纳米孔直接RNA测序中m6A和肌苷的背景假阳性调用。
key_points: 在非DRACH基序m6A上去除92.85%候选，保留93.34%与GLORI匹配
用HEK293T训练权重迁移至HeLa评估
基于公开RNA004数据，分组五折交叉验证
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，仅公开数据交叉验证，属增量偏上
abstract: Nanopore direct RNA sequencing (DRS) can detect multiple RNA modifications, but falsepositive background calls complicate transcriptome-wide analysis. We developed rnaModScan,a deep learning filter that integrates Dorado scores for all eight modification types with local sequence, repeat, and per-read alignment features to distinguish N6-methyladenosine (m6A) and inosine candidates from background calls. Using public RNA004 data, we evaluated site classification by grouped five-fold cross-validation and assessed transfer to HeLa cellular RNA using model weights fitted exclusively to HEK293T cellular RNA and unmodified in vitrotranscribed controls. For m6A sites outside the canonical DRACH motif, filtering removed 92.85% of the Dorado/modkit candidates while retaining 93.34% of their original matches to the GLORI reference map. The F1 score relative to DRS-covered GLORI sites increased from 3.04% to 26.76%. For inosine, filtering removed 83.44% of the candidates while preserving 99.86% of their original Slic-seq matches, and the reference-map F1 score increased from 5.22% to 22.05%. Filtering also brought the motif, repeat, and transcript-position distributions of retained candidates closer to those in the orthogonal short-read maps generated by GLORI and Slic-seq. These results support rnaModScan as a practical complement to Dorado-based RNA004 analysis for prioritizing transcriptome-wide m6A and inosine candidates.Availability: rnaModScan is available at https://github.com/uedaLabR/rnaModScan and archived in Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24546829).Keywords: direct RNA sequencing; RNA modifications; Dorado; deep learning; inosine; m6A
zh_abstract: 纳米孔直接 RNA 测序（DRS）可检测多种 RNA 修饰，但假阳性背景calls 使全转录组分析变得复杂。我们开发了 rnaModScan，这是一种深度学习过滤器，它整合了 Dorado 对全部八种修饰类型的评分，以及局部序列、重复序列和每条读段的比对特征，以区分 N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）和肌苷候选位点与背景calls。利用公开的 RNA004 数据，我们通过分组五折交叉验证评估了位点分类，并使用仅在 HEK293T 细胞 RNA 和未修饰的体外转录对照上拟合的模型权重，评估了向 HeLa 细胞 RNA 的迁移。对于经典 DRACH 基序之外的 m6A 位点，过滤去除了 92.85% 的 Dorado/modkit 候选位点，同时保留了其与 GLORI 参考图谱原有匹配的 93.34%。相对于 DRS 覆盖的 GLORI 位点，F1 分数从 3.04% 提高到 26.76%。对于肌苷，过滤去除了 83.44% 的候选位点，同时保留了其与 Slic-seq 原有匹配的 99.86%，参考图谱 F1 分数从 5.22% 提高到 22.05%。过滤还使保留候选位点的基序、重复序列和转录本位置分布更接近于由 GLORI 和 Slic-seq 生成的正交短读长图谱中的分布。这些结果支持 rnaModScan 作为基于 Dorado 的 RNA004 分析的实用补充，用于优先筛选全转录组 m6A 和肌苷候选位点。可用性：rnaModScan 可在 https://github.com/uedaLabR/rnaModScan 获取，并存档于 Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24546829)。关键词：直接 RNA 测序；RNA 修饰；Dorado；深度学习；肌苷；m6A

title: Evaluation of a Deep Learning Reconstruction Technique for Accelerated Brain MRI Scans.
zh_title: 评估用于加速脑MRI的深度学习重建技术
summary: 论文介绍FDA已清除的深度学习算法DeepFoqus-Accelerate，用于从高度欠采样数据重建脑MRI以缩短扫描时间。
key_points: 算法为FDA cleared的DL重建产品
目标是缩短扫描时间并减少运动伪影
摘要未提供具体评估结果
reason: 已获清除产品评估，但摘要缺乏样本与结果，属增量档
abstract: [Tomography (Ann Arbor, Mich.)] Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a cornerstone of diagnostic imaging, providing exceptional soft tissue contrast and enabling detailed characterization of neurological, vascular, and musculoskeletal diseases. Despite its clinical utility, prolonged acquisition times remain a primary limitation of MRI. Extended scan durations increase patient discomfort, particularly in vulnerable populations, which elevate the risk of motion artifacts that can degrade image quality and necessitate repeat imaging. Recent advances in machine learning, especially deep learning (DL), promise to ameliorate these limitations by enabling high-quality MRI reconstruction from heavily undersampled data, increasing throughput capacity and improving healthcare delivery efficiency. This work describes an FDA-cleared DL algorithm known as DeepFoqus-Accelerate for the reconstruction of deliberately under-sampled magnetic resonance imaging data. Fully sampled k-space from 408 brain MRI volumes (108 from 18 healthy volunteers and 300 from the public fastMRI dataset) was retrospectively undersampled. A detailed comparison of reconstructed images using DeepFoqus-Accelerate with corresponding fully sampled clinical images is presented using expert evaluation of overall image quality and quantitative similarity metrics. The only conventional comparator included in the study was GE's parallel imaging reconstruction (ARC) at matched retrospective undersampling; comparisons with compressed sensing and vendor-specific deep-learning reconstruction methods were outside the study design. This algorithm can allow for a four-fold reduction in brain imaging times relative to a fully sampled acquisition while preserving image quality. No reader rated any reconstruction below the acceptability threshold, and DeepFoqus-Accelerate exceeded ARC on all metrics at 4×. The findings characterize image quality and structural fidelity relative to fully sampled references and support further evaluation of diagnostic performance, with the potential to improve imaging efficiency and patient experience.

abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Digital applications have high potential in myocardial infarction management. This study aims to harmonize personal health data using a workflow driven by an Artificial Intelligence-assisted virtual assistant prototype, then reuse the data to facilitate the creation of standardized patient summaries and risk assessment. The required configurations for data documentation and curation were developed to drive the workflow execution. With consent and data transfer agreements, data of patients with myocardial infarction were extracted from multi-source medical records, structured, and ingested into the workflow. After transformation, personal health data were mapped into concrete clinical concepts connected with specific relationships defined by the reference ontology, forming source health knowledge graphs as the basic structure of personal health knowledge graphs. Then the constructed graphs were validated using Shapes Constraint Language-based constraints, triggering the human-in-the-loop process to enhance data quality. Information queries were conducted for data reuse. Thirty eight out of 45 planned patients were recruited with signed informed consent. Thirty patients finalized the study. The overall successful data ingestion rate is approximately 83%. The average data quality score is 95.45/100. Constructed personal health knowledge graphs can be reused to represent medical information as an international patient summary and evaluate individual risk of future cardiovascular events by calculating the Second Manifestations of Arterial Disease risk score. Our proposed workflow is feasible for semi-automated personal health data curation and secondary use. It provides a potential solution to enhance medical data interoperability, thereby facilitating risk assessment in cardiovascular diseases.

abstract: [Seminars in fetal & neonatal medicine] Neonatal brain injury remains a major contributor to mortality and long-term neurodevelopmental disability worldwide. Over the past two decades, neonatal neurocritical care (NNCC) has emerged as an interdisciplinary model focused on early diagnosis, continuous neuromonitoring, and neuroprotective interventions. Digital health technologies are now accelerating this transformation by expanding access to specialized expertise, enabling remote neuromonitoring, and supporting more standardized and individualized care across geographically distributed neonatal intensive care units (NICUs). This review discusses the evolving roles of telemedicine, multimodal monitoring, immersive technologies, artificial intelligence, and digital data ecosystems in NNCC. We explore current clinical applications, implementation challenges, and future perspectives, including precision neuroprotection, predictive analysis, and longitudinal digital neuro-NICU models. By integrating these technologies, digitally connected NNCC may help shift the field from reactive treatment of established injury toward proactive, precision-based neuroprotection focused on lifelong brain health.

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: The increasing use of dental implants has been accompanied by a rise in peri-implant diseases. As artificial intelligence (AI)-based chatbots are increasingly used to obtain health information, this study evaluated the reliability, quality, usefulness, and readability of responses generated by ChatGPT (GPT-4), Copilot (Smart GPT-5), and Gemini (3.0 Flash) to questions about peri-implant diseases. Methods: Thirty-two AI-generated patient-oriented questions about peri-implant diseases were submitted to each chatbot. The responses were evaluated using the Global Quality Score (GQS), a 4-point usefulness scale, the modified DISCERN (mDISCERN) tool, the Flesch Reading Ease (FRE), and the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL). Inter-rater agreement before consensus was assessed using single-measure, absolute-agreement intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs). Statistical analyses included the Shapiro-Wilk, Kruskal-Wallis, post hoc Bonferroni, and Spearman correlation tests. Results: ChatGPT and Gemini had higher FRE scores and lower FKGL scores than Copilot (all adjusted p < 0.001). Copilot and Gemini had higher mDISCERN scores than ChatGPT (both adjusted p < 0.001), with no significant difference between Copilot and Gemini (adjusted p = 0.129). GQS and usefulness scores did not differ significantly across chatbots. Across the three chatbots, Spearman correlation coefficients ranged from -0.973 to -0.844 for the correlation between FRE and FKGL scores and from -0.773 to -0.509 for the correlation between GQS and usefulness scores. Conclusions: ChatGPT and Gemini produced easier-to-read responses than Copilot, while Copilot and Gemini scored higher than ChatGPT on mDISCERN. The chatbots showed no significant differences in overall quality or usefulness scores. Given their potential limitations in clinical depth, AI-generated responses should be used only as supplementary educational resources and should not replace professional medical advice.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景/目的】种植牙的使用日益增多，种植体周围疾病也随之增加。随着基于人工智能（AI）的聊天机器人越来越多地被用于获取健康信息，本研究评估了 ChatGPT（GPT-4）、Copilot（Smart GPT-5）和 Gemini（3.0 Flash）针对种植体周围疾病相关问题所生成回答的可靠性、质量、实用性和可读性。【方法】向每个聊天机器人提交 32 个由 AI 生成的、面向患者的种植体周围疾病问题。使用全球质量评分（GQS）、4 分制实用性量表、改良 DISCERN（mDISCERN）工具、Flesch 阅读易度（FRE）和 Flesch-Kincaid 年级水平（FKGL）对回答进行评估。采用单次测量、绝对一致性的组内相关系数（ICC）评估达成共识前的评估者间一致性。统计分析包括 Shapiro-Wilk 检验、Kruskal-Wallis 检验、事后 Bonferroni 检验和 Spearman 相关检验。【结果】ChatGPT 和 Gemini 的 FRE 得分高于 Copilot，FKGL 得分低于 Copilot（校正后 p 均 < 0.001）。Copilot 和 Gemini 的 mDISCERN 得分高于 ChatGPT（校正后 p 均 < 0.001），Copilot 与 Gemini 之间无显著差异（校正后 p = 0.129）。各聊天机器人之间的 GQS 和实用性得分无显著差异。在三个聊天机器人中，FRE 与 FKGL 得分之间的 Spearman 相关系数范围为 -0.973 至 -0.844，GQS 与实用性得分之间的相关系数范围为 -0.773 至 -0.509。【结论】ChatGPT 和 Gemini 生成的回答比 Copilot 更易读，而 Copilot 和 Gemini 的 mDISCERN 得分高于 ChatGPT。各聊天机器人在总体质量或实用性得分上无显著差异。鉴于其在临床深度方面可能存在局限，AI 生成的回答只应作为补充性教育资源，不应取代专业医疗建议。

abstract: Brain field potentials (FPs) reflect the combined activity of multiple neural sources, challenging the accuracy of their temporal series and their spatial origin difficult to establish from waveform inspection alone. However, FP generators obtained by independent component analysis exhibit characteristic temporal patterns and unique spatial profiles that allow their identification, even during apparently irregular activity. Here, we compared feature-based machine learning (ML) and end-to-end deep learning (DL) approaches to assess how effectively this information can be extracted from short segments and whether learning directly from raw signals offers advantages over predefined signal descriptors. We analyzed irregular FP-generator activity from multiple hippocampal generators in a dataset pooled across experimenters, recording devices, and electrode types. Feature-based approaches used predefined spectral and nonlinear descriptors to construct multidimensional representations, which were classified using seven ML algorithms: bagged decision trees (BAG), light gradient boosting machine (LGBM), quadratic discriminant analysis (QDA), random forest (RF), support vector machines (SVM), extreme gradient boosting (XGB) and multilayer perceptron (MLP). In parallel, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformer architectures learned discriminative representations directly from raw signals. Performance was evaluated using animal-independent data partitions to assess generalization to previously unseen animals. Both approaches discriminated among FP generators from short segments of irregular activity. Raw-signal models generally achieved higher classification performance than feature-based approaches, although the latter also captured substantial generator-specific information. This suggests that discriminative information extends beyond the predefined descriptors and includes temporal patterns that can be exploited through direct signal learning. Classification across animals further supports the reproducibility of generator-related information despite variability in experimental conditions and recording procedures. These findings provide a scalable quantitative approach to identifying FP generators from irregular activity, opening new possibilities for investigating electrophysiological signals across physiological and pathological conditions.
zh_abstract: 脑场电位（FPs）反映多个神经源的综合活动，这使得其时间序列的准确性受到挑战，且仅凭波形观察难以确定其空间起源。然而，通过独立成分分析获得的FP发生器具有特征性的时间模式和独特的空间分布，即使在看似不规则的活动期间也可据此加以识别。在此，我们比较了基于特征的机器学习（ML）方法与端到端深度学习（DL）方法，以评估能否从短时程片段中有效提取这些信息，以及直接从原始信号学习是否优于预定义的信号描述符。我们分析了来自多个海马发生器的不规则FP发生器活动，所用数据集汇集了不同实验者、记录设备和电极类型的数据。基于特征的方法使用预定义的频谱和非线性描述符构建多维表征，并采用七种ML算法进行分类：装袋决策树（BAG）、轻量梯度提升机（LGBM）、二次判别分析（QDA）、随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）、极端梯度提升（XGB）和多层感知机（MLP）。与此同时，卷积神经网络（CNN）和Transformer架构直接从原始信号中学习判别性表征。采用与动物个体无关的数据划分来评估性能，以考察对未见过动物的泛化能力。两种方法均能根据不规则活动的短时程片段区分FP发生器。原始信号模型总体上取得了高于基于特征方法的分类性能，尽管后者也捕获了大量发生器特异性信息。这提示判别性信息超出了预定义描述符的范围，还包括可通过直接信号学习加以利用的时间模式。跨动物分类进一步支持了发生器相关信息在实验条件和记录流程存在差异的情况下仍具有可重复性。这些发现为根据不规则活动识别FP发生器提供了一种可扩展的定量方法，为研究生理和病理条件下的电生理信号开辟了新的可能。
